links.text_zh: 皋陶辅佐大禹掌刑狱，禹曾举其为继承人。
links.text: Gao Yao served Yu as minister of justice, and Yu named him his successor.

links.text_zh: 奚仲任夏朝车正，为禹掌管车服。
links.text: Xi Zhong served the Xia court of Yu as master of carriages.

links.text_zh: 仪狄造酒献于禹，禹饮而甘之，遂疏远仪狄。
links.text: Yi Di presented wine to Yu, who liked it and then kept Yi Di at a distance.

links.text_zh: 伊尹辅佐商汤灭夏建商。
links.text: Yi Yin helped Tang overthrow Xia and found Shang.

links.text_zh: 仲虺为商汤左相，作《仲虺之诰》。
links.text: Zhong Hui was Tang's left minister and author of the Announcement of Zhong Hui.

links.text_zh: 周武王姬发是周文王之子。
links.text: King Wu was the son of King Wen.

links.text_zh: 比干是纣王的叔父。
links.text: Bi Gan was King Zhou's uncle.

links.text_zh: 纣王宠爱妲己，言听计从。
links.text: King Zhou doted on his consort Daji.

links.text_zh: 微子启是纣王的庶兄，屡谏不听而出走。
links.text: Weizi Qi was King Zhou's elder half-brother and left after his advice was ignored.

links.text_zh: 纣王将西伯昌囚于羑里。
links.text: King Zhou imprisoned King Wen at Youli.

links.text_zh: 伯夷闻西伯善养老，前往归附周。
links.text: Boyi went to join King Wen, hearing he cared well for the old.

links.text_zh: 文王渭水访得吕尚，立为师。
links.text: King Wen found Lü Shang by the Wei River and made him his tutor.

links.text_zh: 姜子牙之女邑姜为周武王王后。
links.text: Jiang Ziya's daughter Yi Jiang was King Wu's queen.

links.text_zh: 比干强谏纣王，被剖心而死。
links.text: Bi Gan remonstrated with King Zhou and was killed by having his heart cut out.

links.text_zh: 伯夷叩马谏阻武王伐纣，后耻食周粟。
links.text: Boyi held King Wu's horse to stop the war and later refused to eat Zhou grain.

links.text_zh: 周公辅佐武王伐纣，作《牧誓》。
links.text: The Duke of Zhou assisted King Wu in the conquest of Shang.

links.text_zh: 姜子牙为武王师尚父，统兵伐纣。
links.text: Jiang Ziya, King Wu's 'Father Shang', led the army against Shang.

links.text_zh: 箕子是纣王的叔父，谏而不听，佯狂为奴。
links.text: Jizi, King Zhou's uncle, feigned madness after his warnings were ignored.

links.text_zh: 武王率诸侯于牧野大败纣王，商亡。
links.text: King Wu crushed King Zhou at Muye, ending Shang.

links.text_zh: 周公旦是武王之弟，辅佐其伐纣。
links.text: The Duke of Zhou was King Wu's younger brother and aide.

links.text_zh: 周武王访箕子，箕子为陈《洪范》九畴。
links.text: King Wu consulted Jizi, who set out the Great Plan (Hongfan).

links.text_zh: 周公摄政辅佐年幼的成王，七年后还政。
links.text: The Duke of Zhou served as regent for young King Cheng, returning power after seven years.

links.text_zh: 召公与周公分陕而治，共辅成王。
links.text: The Duke of Shao shared the regency with the Duke of Zhou for King Cheng.

links.text_zh: 周公作《尚书·君奭》以告召公。
links.text: The Duke of Zhou addressed 'Jun Shi' in the Book of Documents to the Duke of Shao.

links.text_zh: 周成王封微子启于宋，奉殷商祭祀。
links.text: King Cheng enfeoffed Weizi Qi in Song to continue the Shang sacrifices.

links.text_zh: 伯禽受成王之命就封鲁国。
links.text: Bo Qin took up the fief of Lu under King Cheng.

links.text_zh: 伯禽为周公长子，代父受封于鲁。
links.text: Bo Qin, eldest son of the Duke of Zhou, was enfeoffed in Lu in his place.

links.text_zh: 尹吉甫奉宣王之命北伐猃狁。
links.text: Yin Jifu led King Xuan's campaign against the Xianyun.

links.text_zh: 尹吉甫作《诗经·大雅·烝民》送仲山甫。
links.text: Yin Jifu wrote the ode 'Zheng Min' to send off Zhong Shanfu.

links.text_zh: 仲山甫辅佐周宣王，成就宣王中兴。
links.text: Zhong Shanfu served King Xuan in the Zhou revival.

links.text_zh: 周宣王封其弟姬友于郑，是为郑桓公。
links.text: King Xuan enfeoffed his younger brother You in Zheng as Duke Huan.

links.text_zh: 周幽王是周宣王之子。
links.text: King You was the son of King Xuan.

links.text_zh: 史籀为周宣王太史，作《史籀篇》大篆。
links.text: Shi Zhou was King Xuan's grand scribe and compiled the Shi Zhou primer of great seal script.

check.n: Sources call this only a tradition; modern scholars date the Shizhoupian to Qin of the Warring States.
check.n_zh: 来源称此仅为传说，现代学者多认为《史籀篇》为战国秦人所作。

links.text_zh: 伯阳父据三川地震预言西周将亡。
links.text: Bo Yangfu read the Three Rivers earthquake as a sign of Zhou's fall under King You.

links.text_zh: 周幽王宠幸褒姒，烽火戏诸侯。
links.text: King You doted on Bao Si, famously lighting beacons to make her laugh.

links.text_zh: 郑桓公任幽王司徒，与幽王同死于犬戎之乱。
links.text: Duke Huan of Zheng was King You's minister and died with him in the Quanrong attack.

links.text_zh: 鲍叔牙深知管仲，荐其为相，世称管鲍之交。
links.text: Bao Shuya understood Guan Zhong and recommended him: the proverbial friendship.

links.text_zh: 鲍叔牙辅佐公子小白出奔莒，助其即位。
links.text: Bao Shuya accompanied Prince Xiaobai into exile and helped him take the throne.

links.text_zh: 齐桓公不计射钩之仇，拜管仲为相改革。
links.text: Duke Huan forgave Guan Zhong's arrow and made him chancellor to reform Qi.

links.text_zh: 柯之盟上曹沫（一说即曹刿）执匕首劫桓公，迫还鲁地。
links.text: At Ke, Cao Mo (often identified with Cao Gui) held a dagger to Duke Huan to recover Lu land.

links.text_zh: 狐偃是重耳的舅父，人称舅犯。
links.text: Hu Yan was Chong'er's maternal uncle, called 'Uncle Fan'.

links.text_zh: 许穆夫人之舅齐桓公应卫难，出兵救卫。
links.text: Lady Xu Mu's uncle Duke Huan of Qi sent troops to rescue Wey.

links.text_zh: 秦穆公以五张羊皮赎百里奚，任为大夫。
links.text: Duke Mu ransomed Baili Xi for five ram skins and made him minister.

links.text_zh: 狐偃随重耳流亡十九年，辅其回国称霸。
links.text: Hu Yan followed Chong'er through 19 years of exile and helped him to hegemony.

links.text_zh: 百里奚向秦穆公力荐好友蹇叔。
links.text: Baili Xi recommended his friend Jian Shu to Duke Mu.

links.text_zh: 齐桓公与管仲将太子昭托付宋襄公。
links.text: Duke Huan and Guan Zhong entrusted Crown Prince Zhao to Duke Xiang of Song.

links.text_zh: 重耳流亡至齐，齐桓公以宗女妻之。
links.text: When Chong'er reached Qi in exile, Duke Huan gave him a wife of his house.

links.text_zh: 重耳过宋，宋襄公赠马二十乘。
links.text: Duke Xiang of Song gave the exiled Chong'er twenty teams of horses.

links.text_zh: 秦穆公派兵护送重耳回晋即位。
links.text: Duke Mu of Qin escorted Chong'er back to take the Jin throne.

links.text_zh: 介子推割股奉君，晋文公归国后隐居绵山。
links.text: Jie Zitui fed Chong'er his own flesh, then hid on Mount Mian after the return.

links.text_zh: 先轸为晋文公中军元帅，谋胜城濮。
links.text: Xian Zhen commanded Jin's central army for Duke Wen and won at Chengpu.

links.text_zh: 蹇叔谏穆公勿袭郑，哭送秦师，后果败于崤。
links.text: Jian Shu warned Duke Mu against attacking Zheng and wept as the army left.

links.text_zh: 董狐直书“赵盾弑其君”，孔子称良史。
links.text: Dong Hu wrote 'Zhao Dun killed his lord', a model of honest history.

links.text_zh: 孙叔敖任楚庄王令尹，助楚称霸。
links.text: Sunshu Ao served King Zhuang as chief minister, helping Chu to hegemony.

links.text_zh: 季札至晋，悦叔向，临别劝其慎以免难。
links.text: In Jin Ji Zha befriended Shuxiang and warned him to stay cautious.

links.text_zh: 季札聘郑，赠子产缟带，子产报以纻衣。
links.text: Ji Zha gave Zichan a silk sash and received a linen robe in return.

links.text_zh: 季札聘齐，劝晏婴交还封邑以避祸。
links.text: Ji Zha visiting Qi advised Yan Ying to return his fief to avoid danger.

links.text_zh: 晏婴使晋，与叔向共论齐晋季世。
links.text: Yan Ying on a mission to Jin discussed the decline of Qi and Jin with Shuxiang.

links.text_zh: 季札是吴王阖闾（公子光）的叔父。
links.text: Ji Zha was the uncle of King Helu of Wu.

links.text_zh: 叔向致书子产，反对铸刑书。
links.text: Shuxiang wrote to Zichan objecting to his cast law code.

links.text_zh: 子路为孔子弟子，性情刚直，随师周游。
links.text: Zilu, Confucius's bold disciple, followed him on his travels.

links.text_zh: 邓析私作《竹刑》，屡以诉讼诘难子产之政。
links.text: Deng Xi drafted the Bamboo Code and challenged Zichan's government in lawsuits.

links.text_zh: 晏婴向齐景公推荐田穰苴为将。
links.text: Yan Ying recommended Sima Rangju to Duke Jing as general.

links.text_zh: 伍子胥奔吴时对好友申包胥言必覆楚，申言必存楚。
links.text: Fleeing, Wu Zixu told his friend Shen Baoxu he would destroy Chu; Shen vowed to save it.

links.text_zh: 孔子至周，向苌弘请教乐理。
links.text: Confucius consulted Chang Hong on music in Zhou.

check.n: Wikipedia (zh) dates Confucius's visit to Chang Hong to c. 496-495 BC, not 518 BC.
check.n_zh: 维基百科称孔子访乐于苌弘在约前496至前495年，而非前518年。

links.text_zh: 孔子适周，问礼于老子。
links.text: Confucius visited Zhou and asked Laozi about ritual.

check.n: Sources say Confucius asking Laozi about ritual rests on Shiji tradition; modern scholars dispute Laozi's identity and dates.
check.n_zh: 孔子问礼于老子出自《史记》传说，学界对老子身份与年代存在争议，朱熹亦有疑。

links.text_zh: 晏婴劝齐景公不要重用孔子。
links.text: Yan Ying persuaded Duke Jing of Qi not to employ Confucius.

links.text_zh: 伍子胥助公子光夺位，为阖闾筑大城。
links.text: Wu Zixu helped Helu seize the throne and built his capital.

links.text_zh: 孙武以兵法十三篇进见吴王阖闾，拜为将。
links.text: Sun Wu presented his 13-chapter Art of War to Helu and became his general.

links.text_zh: 伍子胥七次向阖闾推荐孙武。
links.text: Wu Zixu recommended Sun Wu to Helu seven times.

links.text_zh: 干将为吴王阖闾铸干将、莫邪二剑。
links.text: Gan Jiang forged the Ganjiang and Moye swords for King Helu.

links.text_zh: 夫差是吴王阖闾之子。
links.text: Fuchai was the son of King Helu.

links.text_zh: 干将与欧冶子同师学艺，俱为铸剑名匠。
links.text: Gan Jiang and Ou Yezi trained under the same master swordsmith.

check.n: Sources describe Ou Yezi as Gan Jiang's teacher (or father-in-law), not a fellow student under the same master.
check.n_zh: 资料称欧冶子是干将的老师（或岳父），而非同师学艺的同门。

links.text_zh: 颜回是孔子最得意的弟子，好学安贫。
links.text: Yan Hui was Confucius's favourite disciple, devoted to learning.

links.text_zh: 子贡为孔子弟子，善言辞，长于经商。
links.text: Zigong was Confucius's eloquent disciple and a successful merchant.

links.text_zh: 孔子称“左丘明耻之，丘亦耻之”，引为同道。
links.text: Confucius said 'What Zuo Qiuming finds shameful, so do I.'

links.text_zh: 颜回与子路同侍孔子，言各言志。
links.text: Yan Hui and Zilu, fellow disciples, shared their aims before Confucius.

links.text_zh: 阖闾伐越，在檇李被勾践击败，伤重而死。
links.text: Helu attacked Yue and was mortally wounded by Goujian at Zuili.

links.text_zh: 伍子胥辅佐夫差，屡谏勿许越和。
links.text: Wu Zixu served Fuchai and repeatedly warned against peace with Yue.

links.text_zh: 范蠡辅佐勾践二十余年，终灭吴国。
links.text: Fan Li served Goujian for over twenty years until Wu was destroyed.

links.text_zh: 夫差在夫椒大败勾践，为父报仇。
links.text: Fuchai crushed Goujian at Fujiao to avenge his father.

links.text_zh: 文种为勾践求和于吴，后助越复国。
links.text: Wen Zhong negotiated peace with Wu for Goujian and helped Yue recover.

links.text_zh: 勾践入吴为夫差奴仆，归国后卧薪尝胆。
links.text: Goujian served Fuchai as a servant, then nursed revenge at home.

links.text_zh: 曾子为孔子晚年弟子，以孝著称。
links.text: Zengzi was a late disciple of Confucius known for filial piety.

links.text_zh: 夫差听信谗言，赐伍子胥属镂剑自杀。
links.text: Fuchai, swayed by slander, ordered Wu Zixu to kill himself.

links.text_zh: 子思名孔伋，是孔子之孙。
links.text: Zisi (Kong Ji) was Confucius's grandson.

links.text_zh: 范蠡致书文种：“蜚鸟尽，良弓藏。”劝其离去。
links.text: Fan Li wrote to Wen Zhong: 'When the birds are gone, the bow is put away.'

links.text_zh: 灭吴后勾践赐文种剑，令其自杀。
links.text: After Wu fell, Goujian sent Wen Zhong a sword ordering his suicide.

links.text_zh: 子思受业于曾子，传儒家心法。
links.text: Zisi studied under Zengzi.

links.text_zh: 墨子与公输般演攻守之术九次，止楚攻宋。
links.text: Mozi beat Lu Ban's nine siege tactics and stopped Chu attacking Song.

links.text_zh: 吴起曾学于曾子，因母丧不归被逐。
links.text: Wu Qi studied under Zengzi, who expelled him for not mourning his mother.

links.text_zh: 魏文侯任西门豹为邺令，治水破河伯娶妇。
links.text: Marquess Wen made Ximen Bao magistrate of Ye, where he ended the river-god brides.

links.text_zh: 吴起为魏文侯将，攻取秦河西之地。
links.text: Wu Qi served Marquess Wen as general and took the Hexi region from Qin.

links.text_zh: 李悝为魏文侯相，主持变法，著《法经》。
links.text: Li Kui led Marquess Wen's reforms and wrote the Canon of Laws.

check.n: Wikipedia (zh) dates Li Kui's appointment as chancellor to 422 BC, far from 406 BC.
check.n_zh: 维基百科称李悝被任为相国在前422年，与前406年相差甚远。

links.text_zh: 商鞅应秦孝公求贤令入秦，主持变法。
links.text: Shang Yang answered Duke Xiao's call for talent and led Qin's reforms.

links.text_zh: 秦惠文王是秦孝公之子。
links.text: King Huiwen was Duke Xiao's son.

links.text_zh: 庞涓忌孙膑之才，诬陷施以膑刑。
links.text: Jealous Pang Juan framed Sun Bin and had his kneecaps removed.

links.text_zh: 庞涓为魏惠王将军，率军攻赵。
links.text: Pang Juan was King Hui's general against Zhao.

links.text_zh: 孙膑在桂陵、马陵两败庞涓，庞涓自刎。
links.text: Sun Bin beat Pang Juan at Guiling and Maling, where Pang killed himself.

links.text_zh: 甘德、石申各测星表，后世合为《甘石星经》。
links.text: Gan De and Shi Shen's star catalogues were later combined as the Gan-Shi Star Canon.

links.text_zh: 魏惠王不用商鞅，后商鞅率秦军大破魏。
links.text: King Hui of Wei declined Shang Yang, who later led Qin to rout Wei.

links.text_zh: 秦惠文王即位后，车裂商鞅。
links.text: King Huiwen had Shang Yang torn apart by chariots.

links.text_zh: 惠施为魏惠王相，促成徐州相王。
links.text: Hui Shi served as King Hui's chancellor and arranged the Xuzhou meeting.

links.text_zh: 张仪与苏秦同师鬼谷子。
links.text: Zhang Yi studied with Su Qin under Guiguzi.

links.text_zh: 庄子与惠施为友，濠梁之上辩鱼之乐。
links.text: Zhuangzi and his friend Hui Shi debated the joy of fish on the Hao bridge.

links.text_zh: 张仪为秦惠文王相，推行连横。
links.text: Zhang Yi became King Huiwen's chancellor and pursued the horizontal alliance.

links.text_zh: 秦昭襄王嬴稷是秦惠文王之子。
links.text: King Zhaoxiang was a son of King Huiwen.

links.text_zh: 苏秦师从鬼谷子，学纵横之术。
links.text: Su Qin learned diplomacy from Guiguzi.

links.text_zh: 淳于髡以“男女授受不亲”诘难孟子。
links.text: Chunyu Kun debated Mencius on whether to save a drowning sister-in-law.

links.text_zh: 孟子见梁惠王，“何必曰利”。
links.text: Mencius told King Hui of Liang: why speak of profit?

links.text_zh: 屈原任楚怀王左徒，遭谗被疏。
links.text: Qu Yuan served King Huai as chief adviser until slander estranged them.

links.text_zh: 苏秦主合纵，张仪主连横，二人分庭抗礼。
links.text: Su Qin championed the vertical alliance and Zhang Yi the horizontal one.

links.text_zh: 孟子驳斥许行君民并耕之说。
links.text: Mencius refuted Xu Xing's idea that rulers should farm alongside the people.

links.text_zh: 张仪以商於六百里诳楚怀王与齐绝交。
links.text: Zhang Yi tricked King Huai with a false offer of 600 li at Shangyu.

links.text_zh: 屈原劝怀王杀张仪，怀王不听。
links.text: Qu Yuan urged King Huai to execute Zhang Yi, in vain.

links.text_zh: 赵武灵王派人自燕迎公子稷归秦即位。
links.text: King Wuling escorted Prince Ji from Yan to take the Qin throne.

links.text_zh: 秦昭王诱楚怀王入秦，扣留不归。
links.text: King Zhaoxiang lured King Huai to Qin and held him captive.

links.text_zh: 孟尝君入秦被扣，以鸡鸣狗盗之计脱身。
links.text: Held in Qin, Lord Mengchang escaped with help of a cock-crower and a thief.

links.text_zh: 孟尝君任齐湣王相国，率联军攻秦。
links.text: Lord Mengchang was King Min's chancellor and led allies against Qin.

links.text_zh: 白起为秦昭王将，伊阙、长平屡立战功。
links.text: Bai Qi was King Zhaoxiang's general, winning at Yique and Changping.

links.text_zh: 齐湣王与秦昭王约称东西二帝。
links.text: King Min and King Zhaoxiang agreed to be emperors of East and West.

links.text_zh: 苏秦为燕反间入齐，事泄被齐车裂。
links.text: Su Qin served Qi as a secret agent of Yan and was executed when exposed.

links.text_zh: 乐毅率五国联军破齐，齐湣王出逃被杀。
links.text: Yue Yi led five states into Qi; King Min fled and was killed.

links.text_zh: 蔺相如携和氏璧入秦，智斗秦王完璧归赵。
links.text: Lin Xiangru outwitted King Zhaoxiang and brought the jade back to Zhao.

links.text_zh: 公孙龙为平原君门客，倡白马非马。
links.text: Gongsun Long, retainer of Lord Pingyuan, argued 'a white horse is not a horse'.

links.text_zh: 赵奢依法杀平原君家人，平原君反荐之于王。
links.text: Zhao She executed Lord Pingyuan's stewards for tax evasion; the lord recommended him.

links.text_zh: 宋玉相传为屈原弟子，同为楚辞名家。
links.text: Song Yu is traditionally Qu Yuan's disciple in the Chuci tradition.

links.text_zh: 荀子在《非十二子》中批评慎到。
links.text: Xunzi criticised Shen Dao in 'Against the Twelve Masters'.

links.text_zh: 廉颇负荆请罪，与蔺相如结刎颈之交。
links.text: Lian Po apologised bearing thorns and became Lin Xiangru's sworn friend.

links.text_zh: 田单施反间使燕撤换乐毅，以火牛阵复齐。
links.text: Tian Dan had Yan replace Yue Yi by intrigue, then retook Qi with fire oxen.

links.text_zh: 黄歇上书秦昭王，劝其勿攻楚。
links.text: Huang Xie (Lord Chunshen) wrote to King Zhaoxiang urging peace with Chu.

links.text_zh: 邹衍适赵，平原君侧行撇席以礼相待。
links.text: Lord Pingyuan received Zou Yan with deep courtesy.

links.text_zh: 范雎献远交近攻之策，任秦相。
links.text: Fan Ju proposed 'befriend the far, attack the near' and became Qin's chancellor.

links.text_zh: 范雎忌白起之功，谗之致其被赐死。
links.text: Fan Ju, jealous of Bai Qi, slandered him toward his death.

links.text_zh: 白起拒攻邯郸，秦昭王赐其自杀。
links.text: Bai Qi refused to attack Handan and King Zhaoxiang ordered his suicide.

links.text_zh: 信陵君窃符救赵，解平原君邯郸之围。
links.text: Lord Xinling stole the tally to save Lord Pingyuan's besieged Handan.

links.text_zh: 邹衍过赵，于平原君处辩倒公孙龙。
links.text: Visiting Zhao, Zou Yan out-argued Gongsun Long at Lord Pingyuan's house.

links.text_zh: 秦昭王以李冰为蜀郡守，修都江堰。
links.text: King Zhaoxiang made Li Bing governor of Shu, where he built Dujiangyan.

links.text_zh: 韩非与李斯同学于荀子。
links.text: Han Fei studied under Xunzi together with Li Si.

links.text_zh: 李斯从荀子学帝王之术。
links.text: Li Si learned statecraft from Xunzi.

links.text_zh: 春申君以荀子为兰陵令。
links.text: Lord Chunshen appointed Xunzi magistrate of Lanling.

check.n: Sources disagree on the year: English passage says Lord Chunshen invited him to Lanling in 240 BCE, Chinese passage says 255 BC.
check.n_zh: 来源年份不一：英文条目称前240年春申君任命其为兰陵令，中文条目称前255年。

links.text_zh: 王贲是秦将王翦之子。
links.text: Wang Ben was the son of General Wang Jian.

links.text_zh: 李斯入秦为吕不韦舍人。
links.text: Li Si entered Qin as a retainer of Lü Buwei.

links.text_zh: 李斯辅佐秦王统一六国，官至丞相。
links.text: Li Si served the King of Qin through unification, rising to chancellor.

links.text_zh: 嬴政即位，尊吕不韦为相国，号仲父。
links.text: When Ying Zheng became king, Lü Buwei was chancellor and 'second father'.

links.text_zh: 韩国水工郑国为秦修渠，间谍事泄仍获续修。
links.text: Han engineer Zheng Guo built Qin's canal and was kept on even after exposed as a spy.

links.text_zh: 扶苏是秦始皇长子。
links.text: Fusu was Qin Shi Huang's eldest son.

links.text_zh: 蒙恬与蒙毅为兄弟，同受始皇信任。
links.text: Meng Tian and his younger brother Meng Yi both enjoyed Qin Shi Huang's trust.

links.text_zh: 嫪毐之乱牵连吕不韦，秦王免其相位。
links.text: The Lao Ai affair implicated Lü Buwei and the king dismissed him.

links.text_zh: 李斯上《谏逐客书》，秦王收回逐客令。
links.text: Li Si's 'Memorial Against Expelling Guest Officials' made the king revoke the order.

links.text_zh: 尉缭说秦王，任为国尉。
links.text: Wei Liao advised the King of Qin and was made defense minister.

links.text_zh: 李斯忌韩非之才，谗之下狱，毒杀之。
links.text: Li Si, jealous of Han Fei, had him jailed and poisoned.

links.text_zh: 扶苏为胡亥长兄，胡亥矫诏夺位，扶苏被逼自尽。
links.text: Fusu was Huhai's eldest brother; Huhai's forged edict usurped the succession and drove Fusu to suicide.

links.text_zh: 高渐离与荆轲交好，易水击筑相送。
links.text: Gao Jianli, Jing Ke's friend, played the zhu to see him off at the Yi River.

links.text_zh: 胡亥是秦始皇少子，即秦二世。
links.text: Hu Hai, the Second Emperor, was Qin Shi Huang's youngest son.

links.text_zh: 王翦攻赵，用反间除去李牧，次年灭赵。
links.text: Wang Jian attacked Zhao, removed Li Mu by intrigue, and took Zhao.

links.text_zh: 荆轲图穷匕见，刺秦王未中被杀。
links.text: Jing Ke drew a dagger hidden in a map but failed to kill the King of Qin.

links.text_zh: 王贲为秦王水灌大梁灭魏，又灭燕、齐。
links.text: Wang Ben flooded Daliang to take Wei for the king, then Yan and Qi.

links.text_zh: 王翦率六十万大军为秦王灭楚。
links.text: Wang Jian led 600,000 men for the King of Qin to conquer Chu.

links.text_zh: 蒙恬为始皇北击匈奴，修筑长城。
links.text: Meng Tian fought the Xiongnu and built the Great Wall for Qin Shi Huang.

links.text_zh: 程邈狱中整理隶书，秦始皇赦而用之。
links.text: Cheng Miao compiled clerical script in prison and Qin Shi Huang adopted it.

links.text_zh: 蒙毅官至上卿，常随始皇出入。
links.text: Meng Yi rose to high minister and attended Qin Shi Huang.

links.text_zh: 秦始皇以巴寡妇清为贞妇，筑女怀清台。
links.text: Qin Shi Huang honoured the widow Qing and built a terrace for her.

links.text_zh: 赵高教胡亥书法与狱律令法。
links.text: Zhao Gao taught Hu Hai writing and law.

links.text_zh: 赵高任中车府令，掌始皇符玺。
links.text: Zhao Gao served Qin Shi Huang as keeper of carriages and seals.

links.text_zh: 徐福奉秦始皇命率童男女入海求仙药。
links.text: Xu Fu sailed with youths for Qin Shi Huang in search of the elixir.

links.text_zh: 赵佗随秦军平百越，任南海郡龙川令。
links.text: Zhao Tuo joined Qin's conquest of the south and became magistrate of Longchuan.

links.text_zh: 高渐离以灌铅之筑击秦始皇未中。
links.text: Gao Jianli struck at Qin Shi Huang with a lead-filled zhu and missed.

links.text_zh: 张良募力士在博浪沙狙击秦始皇。
links.text: Zhang Liang had a strongman ambush Qin Shi Huang at Bolangsha.

links.text_zh: 吕雉嫁刘邦为妻，后为汉朝皇后。
links.text: Lü Zhi married Liu Bang and became Han's empress.

links.text_zh: 扶苏被派往上郡监蒙恬军。
links.text: Fusu was sent to supervise Meng Tian's army in the north.

check.n: Wikipedia says Fusu was sent to the northern frontier as army supervisor under Meng Tian in 212 BC.
check.n_zh: 维基百科称扶苏于前212年被派往北边任蒙恬监军。

links.text_zh: 李斯与赵高合谋立胡亥，后被胡亥腰斩。
links.text: Li Si helped enthrone Huhai and was later cut in two on his orders.

links.text_zh: 沙丘之变，李斯与赵高合谋篡改遗诏。
links.text: At Shaqiu Li Si and Zhao Gao conspired to forge the emperor's will.

links.text_zh: 汉惠帝刘盈是刘邦与吕后之子，继父为帝。
links.text: Emperor Hui was the son of Liu Bang and Empress Lü and succeeded his father.

links.text_zh: 吕后在儿子惠帝在位时掌握实权，鸩杀赵王如意。
links.text: Empress Lü held real power in her son's reign and poisoned his half-brother Ruyi.

links.text_zh: 赵高矫诏赐死扶苏。
links.text: Zhao Gao forged an edict ordering Fusu to die.

links.text_zh: 赵高专权，在胡亥面前指鹿为马，后又逼其自杀。
links.text: Zhao Gao dominated Huhai, calling a deer a horse before him and later forcing him to suicide.

links.text_zh: 赵高矫诏逼蒙恬自尽。
links.text: Zhao Gao forged an edict forcing Meng Tian to die.

links.text_zh: 蒙毅曾判赵高死罪，赵高掌权后杀蒙毅。
links.text: Meng Yi once sentenced Zhao Gao to death; Zhao Gao later had him killed.

links.text_zh: 曹参随刘邦起兵，战功第一。
links.text: Cao Shen rose with Liu Bang and ranked first in battle merit.

links.text_zh: 陈胜与吴广在大泽乡共同起义反秦。
links.text: Chen Sheng and Wu Guang launched the Dazexiang uprising together.

links.text_zh: 樊哙娶吕后之妹吕媭，与刘邦为连襟。
links.text: Fan Kuai married Empress Lü's sister, making him Liu Bang's brother-in-law.

links.text_zh: 项羽随叔父项梁在吴中起兵反秦。
links.text: Xiang Yu rose against Qin at Wu with his uncle Xiang Liang.

links.text_zh: 萧何助刘邦沛县起兵，后镇守关中。
links.text: Xiao He helped Liu Bang rise at Pei and later held Guanzhong.

links.text_zh: 章邯以少府请赦骊山刑徒，为二世击义军。
links.text: Zhang Han armed Lishan convicts for the Second Emperor against the rebels.

links.text_zh: 韩信仗剑从项梁，默默无闻。
links.text: Han Xin joined Xiang Liang's army with his sword but stayed obscure.

links.text_zh: 秦二世听信赵高，诛杀丞相李斯。
links.text: Second Emperor Hu Hai, swayed by Zhao Gao, executed Li Si.

links.text_zh: 刘邦投奔项梁，获兵五千。
links.text: Liu Bang joined Xiang Liang and received 5,000 troops.

links.text_zh: 章邯击破张楚军，陈胜败走被杀。
links.text: Zhang Han crushed Chen Sheng's Zhangchu army; Chen was killed fleeing.

links.text_zh: 章邯夜袭定陶，大破楚军，项梁战死。
links.text: Zhang Han's night attack at Dingtao defeated and killed Xiang Liang.

links.text_zh: 赵高诬李斯谋反，李斯被腰斩。
links.text: Zhao Gao framed Li Si for treason and had him cut in two.

links.text_zh: 项羽破釜沉舟，在巨鹿大破章邯所部秦军。
links.text: Xiang Yu sank his boats and crushed Zhang Han's Qin army at Julu.

links.text_zh: 张苍从刘邦起兵，后任计相。
links.text: Zhang Cang followed Liu Bang and later managed state accounts.

links.text_zh: 张良运筹帷幄，助刘邦定天下。
links.text: Zhang Liang planned Liu Bang's strategy to win the empire.

links.text_zh: 赵高发动望夷宫之变，逼胡亥自杀。
links.text: Zhao Gao's coup at Wangyi Palace forced Hu Hai to suicide.

links.text_zh: 鸿门宴上樊哙闯帐护卫刘邦。
links.text: Fan Kuai burst into the Hongmen banquet to protect Liu Bang.

links.text_zh: 鸿门宴上樊哙闯帐，当面斥责项羽，护刘邦脱险。
links.text: At the Hongmen feast Fan Kuai burst in, rebuked Xiang Yu and got Liu Bang away.

links.text_zh: 刘邦拜韩信为大将，平定魏赵齐。
links.text: Liu Bang made Han Xin grand general; he conquered Wei, Zhao and Qi.

links.text_zh: 韩信暗度陈仓，击败章邯还定三秦。
links.text: Han Xin's secret crossing at Chencang defeated Zhang Han.

links.text_zh: 楚汉相争四年，项羽最终在垓下败于刘邦。
links.text: Xiang Yu and Liu Bang fought for four years until Xiang Yu fell at Gaixia.

links.text_zh: 萧何月下追回韩信，力荐为大将。
links.text: Xiao He chased Han Xin by moonlight and had him made grand general.

links.text_zh: 陈平为刘邦献离间计，间疏项羽君臣。
links.text: Chen Ping's divisive schemes split Xiang Yu from his advisers for Liu Bang.

links.text_zh: 汉文帝刘恒是刘邦第四子，诸吕被诛后入继大统。
links.text: Emperor Wen was Liu Bang's fourth son, enthroned after the Lü clan was destroyed.

links.text_zh: 陈平献计伪游云梦以擒韩信。
links.text: Chen Ping devised the Yunmeng ruse to arrest Han Xin.

links.text_zh: 刘邦伪游云梦，擒韩信降为淮阴侯。
links.text: Liu Bang feigned a trip to Yunmeng, seized Han Xin and demoted him.

links.text_zh: 陆贾谏刘邦“马上得之，宁可马上治之”，著《新语》。
links.text: Lu Jia told Liu Bang one cannot rule from horseback and wrote the New Discourses.

links.text_zh: 冒顿单于在白登山围困刘邦七日。
links.text: Modu Chanyu besieged Liu Bang at Baideng for seven days.

links.text_zh: 张良为吕后献策请出商山四皓，保住太子刘盈。
links.text: Zhang Liang advised Empress Lü to recruit the Four Greybeards, saving her son's place as heir.

links.text_zh: 陆贾出使南越，说服赵佗称臣，二人相得甚欢。
links.text: Lu Jia went as envoy to Nanyue, won Zhao Tuo's submission and became his friend.

links.text_zh: 吕后在长乐宫钟室杀韩信。
links.text: Empress Lü had Han Xin killed in the bell room of Changle Palace.

links.text_zh: 萧何设计诱韩信入宫，助吕后杀之。
links.text: Xiao He lured Han Xin into the palace where Empress Lü killed him.

links.text_zh: 曹参继萧何为相，一遵萧何约束。
links.text: Cao Shen succeeded Xiao He as chancellor and kept all his rules.

links.text_zh: 冒顿致书吕后求娶，言辞轻慢，吕后忍辱回书。
links.text: Modu sent Empress Lü an insulting letter proposing marriage, and she swallowed her pride and replied.

links.text_zh: 汉景帝是文帝之子，父子开创“文景之治”。
links.text: Emperor Jing was Emperor Wen's son; together they made the Rule of Wen and Jing.

links.text_zh: 吕后禁售铁器给南越，赵佗怒而自称南越武帝。
links.text: When Empress Lü banned iron sales to Nanyue, Zhao Tuo declared himself emperor.

links.text_zh: 周亚夫是绛侯周勃之子，亦为名将。
links.text: Zhou Yafu was the son of Zhou Bo and became a great general too.

links.text_zh: 陈平迎立汉文帝，任丞相直至去世。
links.text: Chen Ping helped enthrone Emperor Wen and served him as chancellor until his death.

links.text_zh: 吕后死后，陈平与周勃合谋诛灭诸吕。
links.text: After Empress Lü died, Chen Ping and Zhou Bo together wiped out the Lü clan.

links.text_zh: 周勃夺北军诛诸吕，迎立汉文帝。
links.text: Zhou Bo seized the Northern Army, destroyed the Lü clan and enthroned Emperor Wen.

links.text_zh: 汉文帝作《赐南越王赵佗书》，劝其去帝号归汉。
links.text: Emperor Wen wrote to Zhao Tuo persuading him to drop the imperial title and submit to Han.

links.text_zh: 贾谊受汉文帝赏识，上《治安策》，有“不问苍生问鬼神”之叹。
links.text: Jia Yi served Emperor Wen and submitted his famous memorial on governance.

links.text_zh: 周勃、灌婴等老臣排挤贾谊，使其贬为长沙王太傅。
links.text: Zhou Bo and other veterans pushed Jia Yi out to Changsha.

links.text_zh: 淳于意获文帝赦免后奉诏陈述医案，留下“诊籍”。
links.text: Pardoned by Emperor Wen, Chunyu Yi answered his questions with China's earliest case records.

links.text_zh: 汉文帝劳军细柳营，赞周亚夫为“真将军”。
links.text: Emperor Wen visited Zhou Yafu's camp at Xiliu and praised him as a true general.

links.text_zh: 晁错为景帝“智囊”，力主削藩，七国之乱时被斩。
links.text: Chao Cuo, Emperor Jing's 'bag of wisdom', pushed to curb the princes and was executed in the Seven States revolt.

links.text_zh: 汉武帝刘彻是景帝之子，十六岁继位。
links.text: Emperor Wu was Emperor Jing's son and took the throne at sixteen.

links.text_zh: 周亚夫为景帝平定七国之乱，后下狱绝食而死。
links.text: Zhou Yafu crushed the Seven States revolt for Emperor Jing but later died in prison.

links.text_zh: 枚乘与司马相如同为梁孝王门客，相与游处。
links.text: Mei Sheng and Sima Xiangru were fellow guests at the court of Prince Xiao of Liang.

links.text_zh: 司马相如以琴挑卓文君，二人私奔，当垆卖酒。
links.text: Sima Xiangru won Zhuo Wenjun with his zither; they eloped and ran a wine shop.

links.text_zh: 霍去病是卫青的外甥，十八岁随舅出征。
links.text: Huo Qubing was Wei Qing's nephew and joined his campaigns at eighteen.

links.text_zh: 淮南王刘安是武帝叔父辈，入朝献《淮南子》。
links.text: Liu An, an uncle of Emperor Wu, presented him the Huainanzi.

links.text_zh: 东方朔上书自荐，以诙谐滑稽进谏汉武帝。
links.text: Dongfang Shuo recommended himself to Emperor Wu and admonished him with wit.

links.text_zh: 张骞奉汉武帝之命出使西域，凿空丝路。
links.text: Zhang Qian went west on Emperor Wu's orders and opened the Silk Road.

links.text_zh: 武帝读《子虚赋》召见司马相如，后派其通西南夷。
links.text: Emperor Wu summoned Sima Xiangru after reading his rhapsody and later sent him to the southwest.

links.text_zh: 董仲舒以《天人三策》对汉武帝，倡独尊儒术。
links.text: Dong Zhongshu answered Emperor Wu with his Three Responses urging sole reliance on Confucianism.

check.n: The date of the Three Responses is disputed: Chinese Wikipedia gives 140 BC, others 134 BC.
check.n_zh: 《天人三策》年份有争议：中文维基作建元元年（前140年），另有元光元年（前134年）之说。

links.text_zh: 歌女卫子夫得武帝宠幸，立为皇后，巫蛊之祸中自尽。
links.text: Singer Wei Zifu became Emperor Wu's empress and killed herself in the witchcraft scandal.

check.n: Wikipedia dates Wei Zifu's meeting with Emperor Wu and entry to the palace to 139 BC (Jianyuan 2), not 131 BC.
check.n_zh: 维基称卫子夫被武帝临幸、入宫在建元二年（前139年），而非前131年。

links.text_zh: 卫青是卫子夫之弟，因姐姐入宫而得武帝重用。
links.text: Wei Qing was Wei Zifu's younger brother and rose after she entered the palace.

check.n: Wikipedia dates Wei Zifu's meeting with Emperor Wu and entry to the palace to 139 BC (Jianyuan 2), not 131 BC.
check.n_zh: 维基称卫子夫被武帝临幸、入宫在建元二年（前139年），而非前131年。

links.text_zh: 公孙弘以布衣为丞相封侯，建议设博士弟子员。
links.text: Gongsun Hong rose from commoner to chancellor and proposed students for the Erudites.

links.text_zh: 卫青为武帝大将军，自龙城之战起七击匈奴。
links.text: Wei Qing was Emperor Wu's grand general, campaigning against the Xiongnu from Longcheng on.

links.text_zh: 主父偃向武帝献推恩令，削弱诸侯王。
links.text: Zhufu Yan proposed the Edict of Grace to Emperor Wu to weaken the princes.

links.text_zh: 公孙弘力主诛杀主父偃，武帝遂族灭主父偃。
links.text: Gongsun Hong insisted on Zhufu Yan's execution, and his clan was wiped out.

links.text_zh: 司马迁曾向董仲舒学习《春秋》公羊学。
links.text: Sima Qian studied the Gongyang Spring and Autumn learning with Dong Zhongshu.

links.text_zh: 公孙弘嫉董仲舒，荐其出任骄横的胶西王相。
links.text: Gongsun Hong, jealous of Dong Zhongshu, had him sent as minister to the violent Prince of Jiaoxi.

links.text_zh: 司马迁曾向孔安国请教古文《尚书》。
links.text: Sima Qian consulted Kong Anguo on the old-script Book of Documents.

links.text_zh: 霍去病为武帝骠骑将军，夺取河西，言“匈奴未灭，何以家为”。
links.text: Huo Qubing took the Hexi Corridor for Emperor Wu, saying he would have no home until the Xiongnu were destroyed.

links.text_zh: 张汤穷治淮南王谋反案，刘安被迫自杀。
links.text: Zhang Tang prosecuted the Huainan conspiracy case, and Liu An killed himself.

links.text_zh: 漠北之战李广随卫青出征，迷路失期，愤而自刎。
links.text: Li Guang marched under Wei Qing in the Mobei campaign, lost his way and took his own life.

links.text_zh: 桑弘羊为武帝理财，推行盐铁官营与均输平准。
links.text: Sang Hongyang ran Emperor Wu's finances, setting up the salt and iron monopolies.

links.text_zh: 司马迁任武帝太史令，因李陵事受宫刑，发愤著《史记》。
links.text: Sima Qian was Emperor Wu's Grand Historian, castrated over the Li Ling affair, and finished the Shiji.

links.text_zh: 司马迁与落下闳等共同制定太初历。
links.text: Sima Qian worked with Luoxia Hong and others to create the Taichu Calendar.

links.text_zh: 解忧公主奉汉武帝之命远嫁乌孙和亲。
links.text: Princess Jieyou was sent by Emperor Wu as a bride to the Wusun.

links.text_zh: 苏武奉武帝之命出使匈奴，被扣留牧羊十九年。
links.text: Su Wu went to the Xiongnu as Emperor Wu's envoy and was held there herding sheep for nineteen years.

links.text_zh: 李陵在匈奴劝降苏武不成，苏武归汉时置酒作别。
links.text: Li Ling failed to talk Su Wu into surrender and gave him a farewell feast when he went home.

links.text_zh: 司马迁为降匈奴的李陵辩护，触怒武帝。
links.text: Sima Qian defended Li Ling after his surrender, enraging Emperor Wu.

links.text_zh: 汉宣帝是武帝曾孙，巫蛊之祸中襁褓入狱。
links.text: Emperor Xuan was Emperor Wu's great-grandson, jailed as a baby in the witchcraft scandal.

links.text_zh: 汉武帝临终托孤，命霍光辅佐幼主昭帝。
links.text: Dying, Emperor Wu made Huo Guang regent for the boy emperor Zhao.

links.text_zh: 桑弘羊与霍光政见不合，后因上官桀谋反案被杀。
links.text: Sang Hongyang clashed with Huo Guang and was executed after the Shangguan plot.

links.text_zh: 霍光废昌邑王，迎立汉宣帝，继续辅政。
links.text: Huo Guang deposed the Prince of Changyi and enthroned Emperor Xuan.

links.text_zh: 赵充国七十余岁为宣帝平定西羌，上屯田十二便。
links.text: Over seventy, Zhao Chongguo pacified the Qiang for Emperor Xuan and proposed military farming.

links.text_zh: 刘歆随父刘向校理秘书，后编成《七略》。
links.text: Liu Xin collated the imperial library with his father Liu Xiang and finished the Seven Summaries.

links.text_zh: 陈汤斩郅支单于后遭诋毁，刘向上疏为其请功。
links.text: When Chen Tang was slandered after killing the Zhizhi Chanyu, Liu Xiang petitioned for his reward.

links.text_zh: 扬雄与刘歆交好，刘歆曾笑其《太玄》恐被后人用来盖酱瓿。
links.text: Yang Xiong was Liu Xin's friend; Liu Xin joked his Taixuan would end up covering jars.

links.text_zh: 桓谭深服扬雄，称其书必传于后世。
links.text: Huan Tan admired Yang Xiong and predicted his works would last.

links.text_zh: 刘歆为王莽国师，后谋诛王莽事泄自杀。
links.text: Liu Xin became Wang Mang's State Preceptor, then plotted against him and killed himself.

links.text_zh: 扬雄作《剧秦美新》颂扬王莽新朝。
links.text: Yang Xiong wrote 'Condemning Qin, Praising Xin' in honour of Wang Mang's dynasty.

links.text_zh: 严光是刘秀少年同学，刘秀称帝后屡征不仕，归隐富春江。
links.text: Yan Guang was Liu Xiu's schoolmate who refused office and went fishing on the Fuchun.

links.text_zh: 刘縯与弟刘秀在舂陵起兵反莽。
links.text: Liu Yan rose against Wang Mang with his younger brother Liu Xiu.

links.text_zh: 刘秀初奉更始帝，兄死后隐忍，后出巡河北自立。
links.text: Liu Xiu served the Gengshi Emperor, bore his brother's death, then built his own base in Hebei.

links.text_zh: 更始帝忌刘縯威名，将其杀害。
links.text: The Gengshi Emperor feared Liu Yan's prestige and had him killed.

links.text_zh: 更始军攻入长安，王莽被杀。
links.text: Gengshi's army stormed Chang'an and Wang Mang was killed.

links.text_zh: 刘歆与王涉谋劫持王莽，事泄自杀。
links.text: Liu Xin and Wang She plotted to seize Wang Mang and killed himself when found out.

links.text_zh: 昆阳之战严尤随王邑出征，被刘秀击败。
links.text: Yan You fought with Wang Yi's army at Kunyang and was routed by Liu Xiu.

links.text_zh: 邓禹杖策北渡追随刘秀，位列云台二十八将之首。
links.text: Deng Yu followed Liu Xiu to Hebei and headed the 28 generals of Yuntai.

links.text_zh: 耿弇归刘秀，平定张步，光武赞“有志者事竟成”。
links.text: Geng Yan joined Liu Xiu and conquered Zhang Bu, earning the praise 'where there's a will there's a way'.

links.text_zh: 班彪避乱依隗嚣，作《王命论》劝其归汉。
links.text: Ban Biao took refuge with Wei Xiao and wrote 'On the Mandate' urging him to back Han.

links.text_zh: 樊崇率赤眉军入长安，更始帝降后被缢杀。
links.text: Fan Chong's Red Eyebrows took Chang'an; Gengshi surrendered and was strangled.

links.text_zh: 马援与公孙述同里旧交，往见后讥其为“井底蛙”。
links.text: Ma Yuan visited his old neighbour Gongsun Shu and called him a frog in a well.

links.text_zh: 马援初依隗嚣，奉命出使后归附刘秀。
links.text: Ma Yuan first served Wei Xiao, then joined Liu Xiu after an embassy.

links.text_zh: 樊崇率赤眉在宜阳被光武帝围困，被迫投降。
links.text: Fan Chong's Red Eyebrows were trapped by Emperor Guangwu at Yiyang and surrendered.

links.text_zh: 桓谭当面极言谶纬非经，光武帝大怒欲斩之。
links.text: Huan Tan told Guangwu to his face that prophecy texts were false; the emperor nearly had him beheaded.

links.text_zh: 马援归附光武帝，南征交趾，言“马革裹尸”。
links.text: Ma Yuan served Emperor Guangwu, campaigned in Jiaozhi and vowed to die wrapped in horsehide.

links.text_zh: 光武帝亲征陇右，隗嚣兵败病死。
links.text: Emperor Guangwu campaigned in Longyou and Wei Xiao died in defeat.

links.text_zh: 杜诗为光武帝南阳太守，造水排鼓风冶铁。
links.text: Du Shi served Guangwu as governor of Nanyang and built a water-powered bellows.

links.text_zh: 班超是班彪幼子，投笔从戎。
links.text: Ban Chao was Ban Biao's younger son, who threw down his brush for the army.

links.text_zh: 班固继承父亲班彪续写史书的事业，撰成《汉书》。
links.text: Ban Gu continued his father Ban Biao's history and produced the Hanshu.

links.text_zh: 班固、班超兄弟一文一武，班超曾上书为兄申辩。
links.text: Ban Gu and Ban Chao were brothers, one a historian, one a soldier.

links.text_zh: 吴汉攻破成都，公孙述伤重而死。
links.text: Wu Han took Chengdu and Gongsun Shu died of his wounds.

links.text_zh: 明德马皇后是伏波将军马援之女。
links.text: Empress Ma was the daughter of General Ma Yuan.

links.text_zh: 班昭是班彪之女，博学高才。
links.text: Ban Zhao was Ban Biao's learned daughter.

links.text_zh: 王充到洛阳太学求学，师事班彪。
links.text: Wang Chong studied at the Luoyang academy under Ban Biao.

links.text_zh: 班固死后，班昭续成《汉书》八表与《天文志》。
links.text: After Ban Gu died, Ban Zhao completed the Hanshu's tables and treatise.

links.text_zh: 许慎从贾逵学古文经学，后著《说文解字》。
links.text: Xu Shen learned old-script classics from Jia Kui and later wrote the Shuowen.

links.text_zh: 班固随窦宪北征，作《封燕然山铭》刻石记功。
links.text: Ban Gu joined Dou Xian's campaign and wrote the Mount Yanran inscription.

links.text_zh: 班勇继承父亲班超事业，再度经营西域。
links.text: Ban Yong carried on his father Ban Chao's work in the Western Regions.

links.text_zh: 班超派甘英出使大秦，抵达条支西海。
links.text: Ban Chao sent Gan Ying toward Rome; he reached the western sea.

links.text_zh: 蔡伦受邓太后信任，监造器物，封龙亭侯。
links.text: Cai Lun served Empress Dowager Deng and was made Marquis of Longting.

links.text_zh: 班昭入宫为邓太后之师，号“曹大家”，参与政事。
links.text: Ban Zhao taught Empress Dowager Deng in the palace and advised her on affairs.

links.text_zh: 马融伏于东观阁下，从班昭受读《汉书》。
links.text: Ma Rong studied the Hanshu under Ban Zhao at the Eastern Pavilion.

links.text_zh: 王符与张衡、马融等人交好。
links.text: Wang Fu was a friend of Zhang Heng and Ma Rong.

links.text_zh: 李固反对梁冀立桓帝，遭诬陷下狱致死。
links.text: Li Gu opposed Liang Ji's choice of emperor and was framed and killed.

links.text_zh: 郑玄师从马融，学成东归，马融叹“吾道东矣”。
links.text: Zheng Xuan studied under Ma Rong, who sighed that his teaching had gone east.

links.text_zh: 李膺与陈蕃同为清流领袖，共抗宦官，遭党锢。
links.text: Li Ying and Chen Fan led the scholar party against the eunuchs and were proscribed.

links.text_zh: 李膺赏识郭泰，二人同舟而济，众宾望之如神仙。
links.text: Li Ying admired Guo Tai; seeing them share a boat, onlookers thought them immortals.

links.text_zh: 陈蕃为灵帝太傅，与窦武谋诛宦官失败被杀。
links.text: Chen Fan was Emperor Ling's grand tutor and was killed after a failed plot against the eunuchs.

links.text_zh: 何休作《公羊墨守》，郑玄作《发墨守》驳之。
links.text: He Xiu defended the Gongyang commentary and Zheng Xuan wrote rebuttals of his works.

links.text_zh: 蔡邕奏请正定六经文字，刻熹平石经。
links.text: Cai Yong asked Emperor Ling to fix the classics' texts and carved the Xiping Stone Classics.

links.text_zh: 曹操与袁绍少时交游，同为西园校尉。
links.text: Cao Cao and Yuan Shao were boyhood friends and fellow colonels.

links.text_zh: 孙策是孙坚长子，父死后继承其部曲。
links.text: Sun Ce was Sun Jian's eldest son and inherited his troops.

links.text_zh: 曹操与蔡邕素善，后以金璧赎回其女蔡文姬。
links.text: Cao Cao was Cai Yong's friend and later ransomed his daughter Cai Wenji.

links.text_zh: 蔡邕与刘洪在东观共同续补律历志。
links.text: Cai Yong and Liu Hong worked together on the calendar treatise at the Eastern Pavilion.

links.text_zh: 汉献帝刘协是汉灵帝之子，东汉末代皇帝。
links.text: Emperor Xian, the last Han emperor, was Emperor Ling's son.

links.text_zh: 诸葛瑾是诸葛亮之兄，兄弟分仕吴蜀。
links.text: Zhuge Jin was Zhuge Liang's elder brother; they served Wu and Shu.

links.text_zh: 孙策遇刺临终，将江东基业托付弟弟孙权。
links.text: Dying from an assassin's wound, Sun Ce left the southeast to his brother Sun Quan.

links.text_zh: 孙权是孙坚次子。
links.text: Sun Quan was Sun Jian's second son.

links.text_zh: 关羽追随刘备，恩若兄弟，镇守荆州。
links.text: Guan Yu followed Liu Bei, close as a brother, and held Jing province.

links.text_zh: 皇甫嵩率军镇压张角黄巾军，破广宗。
links.text: Huangfu Song crushed Zhang Jue's Yellow Turbans and took Guangzong.

links.text_zh: 张飞与刘备、关羽恩若兄弟，随刘备征战。
links.text: Zhang Fei was close as a brother to Liu Bei and Guan Yu and fought beside them.

links.text_zh: 曹丕是曹操之子，继位魏王后代汉称帝。
links.text: Cao Pi was Cao Cao's son who succeeded him and ended the Han.

links.text_zh: 董卓强征蔡邕入朝，三日之间周历三台。
links.text: Dong Zhuo forced Cai Yong into office and promoted him three times in three days.

links.text_zh: 董卓废少帝立刘协为帝，专擅朝政。
links.text: Dong Zhuo deposed the young emperor, set up Liu Xie and ruled in his name.

links.text_zh: 吕布杀丁原投董卓，结为父子。
links.text: Lu Bu killed Ding Yuan, joined Dong Zhuo and became his foster son.

links.text_zh: 蔡邕倒屣迎接少年王粲，并赠以藏书。
links.text: Cai Yong rushed out with his shoes on backwards to greet young Wang Can and gave him his books.

links.text_zh: 孔融任北海相，尊郑玄为“郑公”，设郑公乡。
links.text: As governor of Beihai Kong Rong honoured Zheng Xuan and named a district after him.

links.text_zh: 孙策与周瑜同年，总角之好，共定江东。
links.text: Sun Ce and Zhou Yu were boyhood friends of the same age who won the southeast together.

links.text_zh: 夏侯惇从曹操起兵，最受亲信。
links.text: Xiahou Dun joined Cao Cao's first army and was his closest general.

links.text_zh: 袁绍为关东联军盟主，起兵讨伐董卓。
links.text: Yuan Shao led the eastern coalition against Dong Zhuo.

links.text_zh: 孙坚在阳人大破董卓军，斩华雄。
links.text: Sun Jian routed Dong Zhuo's army at Yangren and killed Hua Xiong.

links.text_zh: 荀彧弃袁绍投曹操，建议迎献帝都许。
links.text: Xun Yu left Yuan Shao for Cao Cao and advised bringing the emperor to Xu.

links.text_zh: 曹植是曹操之子，才高八斗，一度受宠。
links.text: Cao Zhi was Cao Cao's brilliant son, once his favourite.

links.text_zh: 曹丕为曹植兄长，二人争立太子，曹丕即位后屡贬曹植。
links.text: Cao Pi, Cao Zhi's elder brother, won the succession contest and kept Cao Zhi sidelined.

links.text_zh: 吕布与王允合谋，刺杀董卓。
links.text: Lu Bu conspired with Wang Yun and killed Dong Zhuo.

links.text_zh: 吕布与曹操争兖州，下邳兵败被缢杀。
links.text: Lu Bu fought Cao Cao for Yan province and was executed after Xiapi.

links.text_zh: 鲁肃指囷赠粮于周瑜，二人结为好友，周瑜临终荐鲁肃自代。
links.text: Lu Su gave Zhou Yu a granary of grain; Zhou Yu later named him his successor.

links.text_zh: 虞翻投奔孙策，任功曹。
links.text: Yu Fan joined Sun Ce as an officer.

links.text_zh: 曹操迎献帝都许，挟天子以令诸侯。
links.text: Cao Cao brought Emperor Xian to Xu and ruled in his name.

links.text_zh: 郭嘉为曹操谋士，助其平定北方，早逝。
links.text: Guo Jia was Cao Cao's strategist in the north and died young.

links.text_zh: 孔融屡次讥讽曹操，终被曹操所杀。
links.text: Kong Rong repeatedly mocked Cao Cao and was finally executed by him.

links.text_zh: 张辽在下邳降曹操，成为曹魏五子良将之一。
links.text: Zhang Liao surrendered to Cao Cao at Xiapi and became one of his great generals.

links.text_zh: 贾诩献离间计，助曹操在潼关破马超、韩遂。
links.text: Jia Xu's ruse to split Ma Chao and Han Sui won Cao Cao the Tong Pass campaign.

check.n: Wikipedia puts the Tong Pass campaign in 211 (Zhong Yao article); 199 is when Zhang Xiu surrendered on Jia Xu's advice.
check.n_zh: 维基将潼关之战置于211年；199年是张绣依贾诩之议降曹。

links.text_zh: 何晏随母尹氏入曹府，为曹操养子，后娶金乡公主。
links.text: He Yan was raised in Cao Cao's household as his stepson after his mother married Cao Cao.

links.text_zh: 官渡之战曹操以少胜多，大败袁绍。
links.text: At Guandu Cao Cao defeated Yuan Shao's larger army.

links.text_zh: 关羽曾暂归曹操，于白马斩颜良报恩后归刘备。
links.text: Guan Yu briefly served Cao Cao, repaid him by killing Yan Liang at Baima, then returned to Liu Bei.

links.text_zh: 孙权劝吕蒙读书，吕蒙后成为东吴名将。
links.text: Sun Quan urged Lu Meng to study, and he became a great general of Wu.

links.text_zh: 鲁肃向孙权献“榻上策”，主张鼎足江东。
links.text: Lu Su gave Sun Quan his 'couch plan' for a southern kingdom.

links.text_zh: 张昭辅佐孙权，为东吴重臣，赤壁前主降。
links.text: Zhang Zhao served Sun Quan as senior minister and urged surrender before Red Cliffs.

links.text_zh: 赵云在长坂坡救护幼主刘禅。
links.text: Zhao Yun protected Liu Bei's infant son at Changban.

links.text_zh: 钟繇为曹操镇守关中，为官渡之战供应战马。
links.text: Zhong Yao held Guanzhong for Cao Cao and sent horses for Guandu.

links.text_zh: 周瑜辅佐孙权，主战抗曹。
links.text: Zhou Yu served Sun Quan and argued to resist Cao Cao.

links.text_zh: 陆逊辅佐孙权，官至丞相。
links.text: Lu Xun served Sun Quan, rising to chancellor.

links.text_zh: 诸葛恪为东吴大将军诸葛瑾长子。
links.text: Zhuge Ke was the eldest son of the Wu general Zhuge Jin.

links.text_zh: 诸葛恪是诸葛亮之侄。
links.text: Zhuge Ke was Zhuge Liang's nephew.

links.text_zh: 曹叡是曹丕长子，继位为魏明帝。
links.text: Cao Rui was Cao Pi's eldest son and became Emperor Ming.

check.n: Wikipedia's Cao Rui article says his parentage is disputed, though Cao Pi's article calls him Cao Pi's eldest son.
check.n_zh: 维基曹叡条称其生父存疑，但曹丕条称其为曹丕长子。

links.text_zh: 曹丕破邺城纳甄氏，后将其赐死。
links.text: Cao Pi took Lady Zhen when Ye fell and later forced her to die.

links.text_zh: 华佗为曹操治头风，后因不愿久留被杀。
links.text: Hua Tuo treated Cao Cao's headaches and was killed for refusing to stay.

links.text_zh: 刘禅是刘备之子，白帝城托孤后即位。
links.text: Liu Shan was Liu Bei's son and succeeded him after Baidi.

links.text_zh: 刘备三顾茅庐，诸葛亮献隆中对，出山辅佐。
links.text: Liu Bei visited Zhuge Liang three times and he left his cottage with the Longzhong plan.

links.text_zh: 诸葛亮号卧龙，庞统号凤雏，并为刘备谋主。
links.text: Zhuge Liang the Sleeping Dragon and Pang Tong the Young Phoenix both advised Liu Bei.

links.text_zh: 刘备联孙抗曹，赤壁战后又夺汉中。
links.text: Liu Bei allied with Sun Quan against Cao Cao at Red Cliffs and later took Hanzhong.

links.text_zh: 司马懿为曹丕“四友”之一，深受信任。
links.text: Sima Yi was one of Cao Pi's four trusted friends.

links.text_zh: 王粲劝刘琮降曹，随后在曹操幕下任职。
links.text: Wang Can urged Liu Cong to surrender and then served Cao Cao.

links.text_zh: 周瑜在赤壁火攻大破曹军。
links.text: Zhou Yu destroyed Cao Cao's fleet with fire at Red Cliffs.

links.text_zh: 孙权以妹嫁刘备，巩固孙刘联盟。
links.text: Sun Quan married his sister to Liu Bei to cement their alliance.

links.text_zh: 曹操率诸子登铜雀台，命作赋，曹植援笔立成《登台赋》。
links.text: Cao Cao had his sons compose rhapsodies on the Bronze Sparrow Terrace; Cao Zhi wrote his at once.

links.text_zh: 鲁肃与吕蒙论议，叹“非复吴下阿蒙”。
links.text: Talking with Lu Meng, Lu Su said he was no longer the old Ameng of Wu.

links.text_zh: 庞统为刘备军师中郎将，入蜀时中箭身亡。
links.text: Pang Tong advised Liu Bei and was killed by an arrow during the Shu campaign.

links.text_zh: 王叔和搜集整理张仲景《伤寒杂病论》，使其流传。
links.text: Wang Shuhe collected and edited Zhang Zhongjing's Treatise on Cold Damage.

links.text_zh: 王粲死后，曹丕率众学驴鸣为其送葬。
links.text: At Wang Can's funeral Cao Pi had mourners bray like donkeys, which Wang Can loved.

links.text_zh: 曹丕与徐干交游，《典论·论文》盛赞其辞赋。
links.text: Cao Pi was a literary friend of Xu Gan and praised his work in 'Discourse on Literature'.

links.text_zh: 曹植作《赠王粲》诗相赠。
links.text: Cao Zhi wrote the poem 'To Wang Can'.

links.text_zh: 法正迎刘备入蜀，深受信任。
links.text: Fa Zheng invited Liu Bei into Shu and became his trusted adviser.

links.text_zh: 马超在潼关与曹操大战，曹操割须弃袍。
links.text: Ma Chao fought Cao Cao at Tong Pass and nearly captured him.

links.text_zh: 司马昭为司马懿次子。
links.text: Sima Zhao was Sima Yi's second son.

links.text_zh: 濡须口对峙，曹操叹“生子当如孙仲谋”。
links.text: Facing Sun Quan at Ruxu, Cao Cao sighed that a son should be like Sun Quan.

links.text_zh: 鲁肃与关羽单刀相会，争荆州，后湘水划界。
links.text: Lu Su met Guan Yu over Jing province and they agreed the Xiang River boundary.

links.text_zh: 张辽在逍遥津以八百人突袭孙权十万大军。
links.text: Zhang Liao charged Sun Quan's huge army with 800 men at Xiaoyao Ford.

links.text_zh: 法正献策，定军山斩夏侯渊，迫曹操退兵汉中。
links.text: Fa Zheng's plan won Dingjun Mountain and forced Cao Cao out of Hanzhong.

links.text_zh: 吕蒙白衣渡江袭取荆州，关羽败走麦城。
links.text: Lu Meng's troops crossed the river disguised as merchants and took Jing; Guan Yu fled to Maicheng.

links.text_zh: 曹丕称帝后猜忌曹植，传有七步成诗之事。
links.text: As emperor Cao Pi persecuted Cao Zhi, giving rise to the Seven-Step Poem story.

links.text_zh: 曹丕逼汉献帝禅让，建立曹魏。
links.text: Cao Pi forced Emperor Xian to abdicate and founded Wei.

links.text_zh: 陆逊在夷陵火烧连营，大败刘备。
links.text: Lu Xun burned Liu Bei's camps at Yiling and routed him.

links.text_zh: 刘备白帝城托孤，诸葛亮辅佐后主刘禅。
links.text: At Baidi Liu Bei entrusted his son Liu Shan to Zhuge Liang, who served as his regent.

links.text_zh: 诸葛亮密表蒋琬为继承人，主持蜀汉朝政。
links.text: Zhuge Liang secretly named Jiang Wan his successor to run Shu.

links.text_zh: 钟会是书法家钟繇的幼子。
links.text: Zhong Hui was the youngest son of calligrapher Zhong Yao.

links.text_zh: 曹丕临终命司马懿等辅政，司马懿辅佐魏明帝曹叡。
links.text: Sima Yi was named an adviser to Cao Rui at Cao Pi's death.

links.text_zh: 诸葛亮北伐前上《出师表》于后主刘禅。
links.text: Before marching north Zhuge Liang presented his Memorial on Dispatching the Troops to Liu Shan.

links.text_zh: 曹植上《求自试表》于魏明帝曹叡，请求为国效力。
links.text: Cao Zhi sent Cao Rui his memorial asking to be allowed to serve the state.

links.text_zh: 姜维降蜀，深受诸葛亮器重，继其北伐之志。
links.text: Jiang Wei joined Shu, was prized by Zhuge Liang and carried on his northern campaigns.

links.text_zh: 王肃之女王元姬嫁司马昭，生司马炎。
links.text: Wang Su's daughter Wang Yuanji married Sima Zhao and bore Sima Yan.

links.text_zh: 司马懿与诸葛亮在祁山、五丈原对峙。
links.text: Sima Yi faced Zhuge Liang at Mount Qi and Wuzhang Plains.

links.text_zh: 孙权围合肥新城，魏明帝曹叡亲征，吴军退走。
links.text: When Sun Quan besieged Hefei, Cao Rui led a relief army and Wu withdrew.

links.text_zh: 诸葛亮死后蒋琬主持蜀汉朝政，辅佐刘禅。
links.text: After Zhuge Liang's death Jiang Wan ran the Shu government for Liu Shan.

links.text_zh: 姜维为后主刘禅大将军，九伐中原。
links.text: Jiang Wei served Liu Shan as grand general and led repeated northern campaigns.

links.text_zh: 马钧任魏给事中，奉魏明帝诏造成指南车。
links.text: Ma Jun, a palace official under Cao Rui, built the south-pointing chariot by his order.

links.text_zh: 司马炎为司马昭长子，266年代魏建晋。
links.text: Sima Yan, Sima Zhao's eldest son, founded the Jin dynasty in 266.

links.text_zh: 晋武帝司马炎是王肃的外孙。
links.text: Emperor Wu of Jin was Wang Su's grandson through his daughter.

links.text_zh: 邓艾出身寒微，为司马懿赏识提拔，主持两淮屯田。
links.text: Deng Ai, of humble origin, was promoted by Sima Yi to run military farms in Huai.

links.text_zh: 孙皓为孙权之孙、废太子孙和之子。
links.text: Sun Hao was Sun Quan's grandson, son of the deposed heir Sun He.

links.text_zh: 何晏激赏少年王弼，二人共倡正始玄学。
links.text: He Yan admired the young Wang Bi and the two led the Zhengshi school of Xuanxue.

links.text_zh: 王弼与钟会友善，常共论玄理。
links.text: Wang Bi and Zhong Hui were friends who debated metaphysics together.

links.text_zh: 康僧会至建业，孙权为其建建初寺。
links.text: Kang Senghui came to Jianye and Sun Quan built the Jianchu Temple for him.

links.text_zh: 高平陵之变后，何晏作为曹爽党羽被司马懿诛杀。
links.text: After the Gaopingling coup Sima Yi executed He Yan as a partisan of Cao Shuang.

links.text_zh: 杜预娶司马昭之妹高陆公主。
links.text: Du Yu married Sima Zhao's sister, Princess Gaolu.

links.text_zh: 向秀与嵇康交好，常在洛阳城外共同打铁。
links.text: Xiang Xiu and Ji Kang were close friends who worked a forge together near Luoyang.

check.n: Wikipedia places Ji Kang and Xiang Xiu's forge at Shanyang (modern Jiaozuo), not near Luoyang.
check.n_zh: 维基称嵇康与向秀锻铁于河内山阳（今焦作），并非洛阳城外。

links.text_zh: 刘伶与阮籍、嵇康相遇，欣然神解，同游竹林。
links.text: Liu Ling met Ruan Ji and Ji Kang and joined their Bamboo Grove circle.

links.text_zh: 阮籍与嵇康同为竹林七贤，阮籍以青眼相待嵇康。
links.text: Ruan Ji and Ji Kang were fellow Bamboo Grove sages; Ruan greeted Ji with "green eyes" of favour.

links.text_zh: 山涛与嵇康、阮籍结为竹林之游，嵇康临刑托子于山涛。
links.text: Shan Tao was Ji Kang's friend in the Bamboo Grove; before death Ji entrusted his son to Shan.

links.text_zh: 阮籍与年少的王戎结为忘年交，引入竹林之游。
links.text: Ruan Ji befriended the much younger Wang Rong and brought him into the Bamboo Grove.

links.text_zh: 孙权临终以诸葛恪为太傅，托付幼主孙亮。
links.text: On his deathbed Sun Quan made Zhuge Ke regent for the young heir Sun Liang.

links.text_zh: 陈寿早年仕蜀汉为观阁令史。
links.text: Chen Shou began his career as an archivist in Liu Shan's Shu court.

links.text_zh: 阮籍任司马昭从事中郎，佯醉避祸，曾代写劝进笺。
links.text: Ruan Ji served on Sima Zhao's staff, feigning drunkenness to stay safe.

links.text_zh: 钟会为司马昭心腹谋士，平诸葛诞、伐蜀皆参与。
links.text: Zhong Hui was Sima Zhao's trusted adviser and led the conquest of Shu for him.

links.text_zh: 姜维与邓艾在段谷交战，蜀军大败。
links.text: Jiang Wei fought Deng Ai at Duangu and suffered a heavy defeat.

links.text_zh: 山涛举嵇康自代，嵇康作《与山巨源绝交书》拒之。
links.text: When Shan Tao recommended him for office, Ji Kang refused in his Letter Breaking Off Relations with Shan Juyuan.

links.text_zh: 司马昭听信钟会之言，下令处死嵇康。
links.text: Sima Zhao ordered Ji Kang's execution on Zhong Hui's advice.

links.text_zh: 嵇康被杀后，向秀经其旧居作《思旧赋》悼念。
links.text: After Ji Kang's execution Xiang Xiu passed his old home and wrote the Rhapsody Recalling Old Friends.

links.text_zh: 钟会访嵇康遭冷遇，后向司马昭进谗促其被杀。
links.text: Snubbed by Ji Kang, Zhong Hui slandered him to Sima Zhao and helped bring about his execution.

links.text_zh: 邓艾偷渡阴平直逼成都，刘禅出城投降。
links.text: Deng Ai marched through Yinping to Chengdu, where Liu Shan surrendered to him.

links.text_zh: 裴秀为司马昭心腹，参与制定官制礼仪。
links.text: Pei Xiu was a close aide of Sima Zhao and helped design the new court system.

links.text_zh: 蜀亡后姜维诈降钟会，劝其据蜀反魏，二人同死乱军。
links.text: After Shu fell Jiang Wei encouraged Zhong Hui's revolt; both died in the uprising.

links.text_zh: 刘禅降魏后居洛阳，对司马昭言“此间乐，不思蜀”。
links.text: Living in Luoyang after surrender, Liu Shan told Sima Zhao he was too happy to miss Shu.

links.text_zh: 钟会诬告邓艾谋反，邓艾被槛车押送后遇害。
links.text: Zhong Hui falsely accused Deng Ai of treason, leading to Deng Ai's arrest and death.

links.text_zh: 山涛入晋任吏部尚书，主持选官，作“山公启事”。
links.text: Shan Tao served Emperor Wu of Jin as head of personnel, famous for his recommendations.

links.text_zh: 王蕃直言忤孙皓，在宴席上被孙皓处死。
links.text: Wang Fan offended Sun Hao with his candour and was executed at a banquet.

links.text_zh: 张华力劝晋武帝伐吴，参与谋划平吴。
links.text: Zhang Hua urged Emperor Wu of Jin to conquer Wu and helped plan the campaign.

links.text_zh: 晋武帝命羊祜镇守襄阳，筹划灭吴。
links.text: Emperor Wu sent Yang Hu to hold Xiangyang and prepare the conquest of Wu.

links.text_zh: 王濬曾为羊祜参军，羊祜密表荐其可当大任。
links.text: Wang Jun served on Yang Hu's staff, and Yang secretly recommended him for high command.

links.text_zh: 郭象《庄子注》承袭向秀之注而成，世说称其窃取。
links.text: Guo Xiang's Zhuangzi commentary built on Xiang Xiu's, and was even said to be lifted from it.

links.text_zh: 晋武帝为太子司马衷聘贾充之女贾南风为妃。
links.text: Emperor Wu took Jia Nanfeng as the wife of his heir Sima Zhong.

links.text_zh: 王濬奉晋武帝之命在蜀中大造楼船。
links.text: Wang Jun built a great fleet in Shu on Emperor Wu's orders.

links.text_zh: 杜预为晋武帝镇南大将军，主持伐吴。
links.text: Du Yu served Emperor Wu as Southern Command general and led the war on Wu.

links.text_zh: 羊祜临终举荐杜预接替自己镇守荆州。
links.text: On his deathbed Yang Hu named Du Yu as his successor in Jing province.

links.text_zh: 张华爱陈寿之才，举荐其任著作郎。
links.text: Zhang Hua admired Chen Shou's talent and recommended him as court historian.

links.text_zh: 杜预致书王濬，鼓励其顺江直取建业。
links.text: Du Yu wrote to Wang Jun urging him to sail straight on to Jianye.

links.text_zh: 左思《三都赋》成，请皇甫谧作序，赋名大振。
links.text: Huangfu Mi wrote a preface for Zuo Si's Three Capitals Rhapsody, making it famous.

links.text_zh: 王濬楼船直下石头城，孙皓出降，吴亡。
links.text: Wang Jun's fleet reached Stone City and Sun Hao surrendered, ending Wu.

links.text_zh: 张华读《三都赋》称其“班张之流”，洛阳为之纸贵。
links.text: Zhang Hua praised Zuo Si's rhapsody, and paper grew dear in Luoyang.

links.text_zh: 陆机初笑左思作《三都赋》，见成书后叹服搁笔。
links.text: Lu Ji first mocked Zuo Si's project, then admired the finished rhapsody and gave up his own.

links.text_zh: 陆机入洛拜见张华，张华叹“伐吴之役，利获二俊”。
links.text: When Lu Ji came to Luoyang, Zhang Hua said the conquest of Wu had gained two talents.

links.text_zh: 刘琨与祖逖同寝，闻鸡起舞，相约报国。
links.text: Liu Kun and Zu Ti shared quarters, rising at cockcrow to drill together.

links.text_zh: 贾后专政时委张华以朝政，后同被赵王伦所杀。
links.text: Empress Jia entrusted government to Zhang Hua; both were killed when Prince Lun seized power.

links.text_zh: 刘琨年少时为金谷二十四友之一，常游石崇金谷园。
links.text: Young Liu Kun belonged to the Twenty-Four Friends who met at Shi Chong's Jingu Garden.

links.text_zh: 陆机与潘岳同为金谷二十四友，并称“潘江陆海”。
links.text: Lu Ji and Pan Yue were both in the Twenty-Four Friends and were paired as the era's top writers.

links.text_zh: 潘岳与石崇交好，同游金谷园，300年同日被杀。
links.text: Pan Yue and Shi Chong were friends of the Jingu Garden and were executed on the same day in 300.

links.text_zh: 潘岳依附贾氏，为贾后草拟陷害愍怀太子的文书。
links.text: Pan Yue attached himself to the Jia clan and drafted the letter used to frame the crown prince.

links.text_zh: 王羲之是王导的从侄，出身琅琊王氏。
links.text: Wang Xizhi was a nephew of Wang Dao in the Langya Wang clan.

links.text_zh: 王导劝司马睿南渡建邺，经营江东，时称“王与马共天下”。
links.text: Wang Dao brought Sima Rui south to Jianye and built his regime, sharing power with him.

links.text_zh: 佛图澄以神异折服石勒，被尊为大和尚。
links.text: Fotudeng won Shi Le over with his powers and became his revered adviser.

links.text_zh: 王羲之少时从卫夫人学书。
links.text: As a boy Wang Xizhi learned calligraphy from Lady Wei.

links.text_zh: 刘曜攻陷晋阳，刘琨借拓跋猗卢兵反攻收复。
links.text: Liu Yao took Jinyang and Liu Kun won it back with Tuoba Yilu's troops.

links.text_zh: 刘琨据并州与石勒相持，曾致书招降石勒。
links.text: Liu Kun held Bing province against Shi Le and even wrote urging him to submit.

links.text_zh: 祖逖请命北伐，司马睿仅给千人粮、三千匹布。
links.text: Zu Ti asked Sima Rui to lead a northern campaign and was given meagre supplies.

links.text_zh: 陶侃为司马睿平定荆湘杜弢之乱。
links.text: Tao Kan suppressed Du Tao's rebellion in Jing and Xiang for Sima Rui.

links.text_zh: 王导上疏置史官，干宝以著作郎修撰《晋纪》。
links.text: On Wang Dao's proposal for a history office, Gan Bao was made court historian to write the Jin Annals.

links.text_zh: 司马睿为丞相时辟葛洪为掾，赐爵关内侯。
links.text: Sima Rui appointed Ge Hong to his staff and enfeoffed him as a marquis.

links.text_zh: 刘琨领衔上《劝进表》，拥戴司马睿称帝。
links.text: Liu Kun headed the Memorial Urging Accession that asked Sima Rui to take the throne.

links.text_zh: 郭璞为王导所重，引为参军。
links.text: Wang Dao valued Guo Pu and made him his staff officer.

links.text_zh: 祖逖北伐收复河南，与石勒对峙，石勒不敢南犯。
links.text: Zu Ti recovered land south of the Yellow River and held off Shi Le.

links.text_zh: 石勒亲率大军在洛阳大破刘曜并将其擒杀。
links.text: Shi Le crushed Liu Yao at Luoyang, captured and killed him.

links.text_zh: 道安师事佛图澄于邺城。
links.text: Dao'an studied under Fotudeng at Ye.

links.text_zh: 谢玄是谢安之侄，谢安举贤不避亲，令其组建北府兵。
links.text: Xie Xuan was Xie An's nephew, whom Xie An put in charge of the Northern Garrison.

links.text_zh: 王献之为王羲之第七子，父子并称“二王”。
links.text: Wang Xianzhi was Wang Xizhi's seventh son; together they are the Two Wangs.

check.n: One zh passage says 第八子, others show seventh son/youngest; sources differ.
check.n_zh: 中文条目一处称献之为第八子，他处称第七子或幼子，说法不一。

links.text_zh: 桓温伐成汉，常璩劝李势出降，后入东晋。
links.text: When Huan Wen attacked Cheng-Han, Chang Qu urged its ruler to surrender to him.

links.text_zh: 谢安与王羲之交好，同登冶城、同游兰亭。
links.text: Xie An and Wang Xizhi were close friends who attended the Orchid Pavilion gathering.

links.text_zh: 慧远听道安讲《般若经》后出家，师事道安。
links.text: Huiyuan became a monk after hearing Dao'an preach and became his disciple.

links.text_zh: 桓温北伐至灞上，王猛披褐求见，扪虱而谈天下事。
links.text: When Huan Wen reached Bashang, Wang Meng visited him and talked of affairs while picking lice.

links.text_zh: 苻坚重用王猛为丞相，自比刘备得孔明。
links.text: Fu Jian made Wang Meng his chief minister, likening himself to Liu Bei with Zhuge Liang.

links.text_zh: 顾恺之为桓温大司马参军，深受亲昵。
links.text: Gu Kaizhi served on Huan Wen's staff and was a favourite.

links.text_zh: 谢安称顾恺之画“自生人以来未之有也”。
links.text: Xie An said there had been nothing like Gu Kaizhi's painting since humankind began.

links.text_zh: 桓温欲篡位，于新亭设伏谋杀谢安，谢安从容化解。
links.text: Huan Wen planned to kill Xie An at Xinting, but Xie An's composure defused it.

links.text_zh: 王献之曾任谢安长史，深受器重。
links.text: Wang Xianzhi served as Xie An's chief aide.

links.text_zh: 苻坚攻襄阳得道安，称“得一人半”，尊为国师。
links.text: Fu Jian took Xiangyang partly to win Dao'an and honoured him in Chang'an.

links.text_zh: 谢安坐镇建康指挥淝水之战，大败苻坚。
links.text: Xie An directed the Battle of Fei River from Jiankang and routed Fu Jian.

links.text_zh: 谢玄率北府兵在淝水大破苻坚百万之众。
links.text: Xie Xuan led the Northern Garrison to crush Fu Jian's host at the Fei River.

links.text_zh: 谢灵运为谢玄之孙，袭封康乐公。
links.text: Xie Lingyun was Xie Xuan's grandson and inherited his title, Duke of Kangle.

links.text_zh: 戴逵作《释疑论》致书慧远，辩论因果报应。
links.text: Dai Kui wrote to Huiyuan disputing karmic retribution in his Resolving Doubts.

check.n: Wikipedia dates Dai Kui's Resolving Doubts and letter to Huiyuan to 393 or 394, not 390.
check.n_zh: 维基称戴逵撰《释疑论》并致书慧远在393或394年，而非390年。

links.text_zh: 刘义庆为刘裕之侄，袭封临川王。
links.text: Liu Yiqing was Liu Yu's nephew and became Prince of Linchuan.

links.text_zh: 檀道济随刘裕京口起兵，后为北伐先锋。
links.text: Tan Daoji joined Liu Yu's rising at Jingkou and led his northern vanguards.

links.text_zh: 陶渊明曾任镇军将军刘裕的参军。
links.text: Tao Yuanming served briefly as an aide to General Liu Yu.

links.text_zh: 慧远与鸠摩罗什书信问答佛理，辑为《大乘大义章》。
links.text: Huiyuan and Kumarajiva exchanged letters on doctrine, later collected as the Dasheng Dayi Zhang.

links.text_zh: 刘义隆为刘裕第三子，即宋文帝。
links.text: Liu Yilong, Emperor Wen of Song, was Liu Yu's third son.

links.text_zh: 谢灵运应慧远之请作《佛影铭》，慧远卒后又作诔。
links.text: Xie Lingyun wrote the Buddha Shadow Inscription at Huiyuan's request and later his eulogy.

links.text_zh: 裴松之随刘裕北伐，刘裕称其为“廊庙之才”。
links.text: Pei Songzhi followed Liu Yu north and was praised by him as fit for high office.

links.text_zh: 谢灵运曾任刘裕太尉参军。
links.text: Xie Lingyun served on Liu Yu's staff as an aide.

links.text_zh: 颜延之与谢灵运文名相当，并称“颜谢”。
links.text: Yan Yanzhi and Xie Lingyun were the era's twin literary stars, known as Yan-Xie.

links.text_zh: 崔浩师事寇谦之，共同向太武帝推崇天师道。
links.text: Cui Hao revered Kou Qianzhi and joined him in promoting Celestial Master Daoism at court.

links.text_zh: 崔浩为太武帝拓跋焘谋主，参与统一北方。
links.text: Cui Hao was Emperor Taiwu's chief strategist in uniting the north.

links.text_zh: 寇谦之献道书，太武帝亲受符箓，崇奉天师道。
links.text: Kou Qianzhi presented his scriptures and Emperor Taiwu adopted Celestial Master Daoism.

links.text_zh: 颜延之与陶渊明交好，赴任途经浔阳赠钱二万。
links.text: Yan Yanzhi was a close friend of Tao Yuanming and left him twenty thousand cash.

links.text_zh: 江州刺史檀道济往访陶渊明，馈以粱肉，被陶渊明拒绝。
links.text: Tan Daoji visited Tao Yuanming with food, which Tao refused.

links.text_zh: 陶渊明卒，颜延之作《陶征士诔》。
links.text: When Tao Yuanming died, Yan Yanzhi wrote the Eulogy for the Recluse Tao.

links.text_zh: 宋文帝命裴松之注《三国志》，书成称“不朽”。
links.text: Emperor Wen ordered Pei Songzhi to annotate the Records of the Three Kingdoms and praised the result.

links.text_zh: 范晔仕宋文帝，后因谋立刘义康被诛。
links.text: Fan Ye served Emperor Wen of Song and was executed for plotting to enthrone Liu Yikang.

links.text_zh: 何承天作《达性论》，颜延之作文驳难，往复辩论佛理。
links.text: He Chengtian's On Understanding Nature drew rebuttals from Yan Yanzhi in a debate over Buddhism.

links.text_zh: 谢灵运屡犯法度，宋文帝下诏将其弃市。
links.text: Emperor Wen of Song finally had the unruly Xie Lingyun executed.

links.text_zh: 宋文帝疑忌檀道济，召而杀之，道济叹“乃坏汝万里长城”。
links.text: Emperor Wen of Song had Tan Daoji killed; Tan cried that they were destroying their Great Wall.

links.text_zh: 鲍照献诗于临川王刘义庆，被擢为国侍郎。
links.text: Bao Zhao presented poems to Liu Yiqing and was taken onto his staff.

links.text_zh: 何承天仕宋文帝，上《元嘉历》。
links.text: He Chengtian served Emperor Wen of Song and presented the Yuanjia calendar.

links.text_zh: 崔浩修国史直书拓跋先世，被太武帝诛灭全族。
links.text: Emperor Taiwu executed Cui Hao and his clan over his candid state history.

links.text_zh: 宋文帝元嘉北伐失败，太武帝反攻直抵瓜步。
links.text: Emperor Wen's northern campaign failed and Emperor Taiwu counterattacked to the Yangtze.

links.text_zh: 冯太后为孝文帝祖母，亲自抚养并临朝辅政。
links.text: Empress Dowager Feng was Emperor Xiaowen's grandmother, raised him and ruled as regent.

links.text_zh: 沈约与谢朓同为竟陵八友，共创永明体。
links.text: Shen Yue and Xie Tiao were among the Eight Friends of Jingling and created the Yongming style.

links.text_zh: 萧衍与谢朓同游竟陵王萧子良门下，为八友。
links.text: Xiao Yan and Xie Tiao were fellow members of the Eight Friends of Jingling.

links.text_zh: 沈约作《难范缜神灭论》驳斥范缜。
links.text: Shen Yue wrote a rebuttal of Fan Zhen's On the Destruction of the Soul.

links.text_zh: 郦道元任尚书主客郎，随孝文帝北巡。
links.text: Li Daoyuan served Emperor Xiaowen and accompanied his northern tour.

links.text_zh: 钟嵘自述谢朓曾与他极论诗道。
links.text: Zhong Rong recalled long discussions of poetry with Xie Tiao.

links.text_zh: 谢朓冤死狱中，沈约作《伤谢朓》哀之。
links.text: When Xie Tiao died in prison, Shen Yue mourned him in Lament for Xie Tiao.

links.text_zh: 刘勰负书拦沈约车求见，沈约读后大为赏识。
links.text: Liu Xie waylaid Shen Yue's carriage with his book, and Shen Yue praised it highly.

links.text_zh: 萧统为梁武帝萧衍长子，立为太子，谥昭明。
links.text: Xiao Tong, Crown Prince Zhaoming, was Xiao Yan's eldest son.

links.text_zh: 江淹入梁任金紫光禄大夫，晚年有“江郎才尽”之叹。
links.text: Jiang Yan served Emperor Wu of Liang in his later years.

links.text_zh: 沈约助萧衍代齐建梁，任尚书令。
links.text: Shen Yue helped Xiao Yan found the Liang and became his chief minister.

links.text_zh: 梁武帝每有大事咨询隐居的陶弘景，时称“山中宰相”。
links.text: Emperor Wu consulted the hermit Tao Hongjing on state affairs, calling him the prime minister in the mountains.

links.text_zh: 钟嵘求誉于沈约不得，《诗品》置沈约于中品。
links.text: Rebuffed by Shen Yue, Zhong Rong ranked him only in the middle grade of his Poetry Grades.

links.text_zh: 梁武帝发起王公朝贵六十余人围攻范缜《神灭论》。
links.text: Emperor Wu of Liang rallied over sixty courtiers to refute Fan Zhen's On the Destruction of the Soul.

links.text_zh: 刘勰任东宫通事舍人，深得昭明太子萧统爱接。
links.text: Liu Xie served Crown Prince Xiao Tong, who valued him greatly.

check.n: Source dates Liu Xie's post as Xiao Tong's secretary to c. 510-513, not clearly 518.
check.n_zh: 资料推断刘勰任萧统通事舍人约在510至513年前后，并非明确的518年。

links.text_zh: 宋云奉胡太后之命与惠生西行取经。
links.text: Song Yun was sent west by Empress Dowager Hu to seek Buddhist scriptures.

links.text_zh: 达摩至建康与梁武帝问答，机缘不契，遂渡江北上。
links.text: Bodhidharma met Emperor Wu at Jiankang, found no meeting of minds and went north.

check.n: Source dates Bodhidharma's meeting with Emperor Wu to 527 and it is a later legend.
check.n_zh: 资料称达摩见梁武帝在527年，且为后世记载的传说。

links.text_zh: 张僧繇为梁武帝画诸王像及佛寺壁画。
links.text: Zhang Sengyou painted portraits of the princes and temple murals for Emperor Wu.

links.text_zh: 高欢投奔尔朱荣，成为其亲信都督。
links.text: Gao Huan joined Erzhu Rong and became one of his trusted commanders.

links.text_zh: 尔朱荣入洛，将胡太后与幼主沉于黄河。
links.text: Erzhu Rong entered Luoyang and drowned Empress Dowager Hu in the Yellow River.

links.text_zh: 侯景为尔朱荣先锋，擒获葛荣。
links.text: Hou Jing served as Erzhu Rong's vanguard and captured Ge Rong.

links.text_zh: 陈庆之白袍军攻入洛阳，后被尔朱荣击退。
links.text: Chen Qingzhi's white-robed army took Luoyang but was driven out by Erzhu Rong.

links.text_zh: 陈庆之为梁武帝旧部，奉命护送元颢北伐。
links.text: Chen Qingzhi, Emperor Wu's long-time follower, led the northern expedition at his order.

links.text_zh: 徐陵与庾信同在东宫，文风并称“徐庾体”。
links.text: Xu Ling and Yu Xin served together in the crown prince's palace; their style was called Xu-Yu.

links.text_zh: 侯景归附高欢，专制河南十四年。
links.text: Hou Jing served Gao Huan and controlled Henan for him.

links.text_zh: 魏收入高欢幕府，后在北齐修《魏书》。
links.text: Wei Shou joined Gao Huan's government and later wrote the Book of Wei under Northern Qi.

links.text_zh: 高欢与宇文泰会战沙苑，宇文泰以少胜多。
links.text: Gao Huan fought Yuwen Tai at Shayuan, where Yuwen Tai won against the odds.

links.text_zh: 兰陵王高长恭为高欢之孙、高澄之子。
links.text: Gao Changgong was Gao Huan's grandson through Gao Cheng.

links.text_zh: 苏绰为宇文泰制定六条诏书，推行改革。
links.text: Su Chuo drafted the Six Edicts for Yuwen Tai's reforms.

links.text_zh: 斛律光少年从军，邙山之战擒宇文泰长史，受高欢提拔。
links.text: Young Hulü Guang captured Yuwen Tai's chief of staff at Mangshan and was promoted by Gao Huan.

links.text_zh: 宇文邕为宇文泰第四子，即北周武帝。
links.text: Yuwen Yong, Emperor Wu of Northern Zhou, was Yuwen Tai's fourth son.

links.text_zh: 陈霸先仕梁，平定交州李贲之乱。
links.text: Chen Baxian served the Liang and crushed Li Bi's revolt in Jiaozhou.

links.text_zh: 高欢死后侯景叛东魏，以河南降梁。
links.text: After Gao Huan's death Hou Jing defected to Liang with Henan.

links.text_zh: 侯景反叛攻陷台城，梁武帝被困饿死。
links.text: Hou Jing rebelled and took the palace city; Emperor Wu died of starvation in confinement.

links.text_zh: 梁武帝遣使迎请真谛，真谛抵建康受礼遇。
links.text: Emperor Wu of Liang invited Paramartha, who was received with honour in Jiankang.

links.text_zh: 庾信率兵守朱雀航，侯景兵至，庾信弃军逃走。
links.text: Yu Xin held the Zhuque bridge against Hou Jing but fled when the rebels arrived.

links.text_zh: 冼夫人会见陈霸先，认定其非常人，助其平侯景。
links.text: Lady Xian met Chen Baxian, judged him exceptional and backed him against Hou Jing.

links.text_zh: 陈霸先与王僧辩合兵平定侯景之乱。
links.text: Chen Baxian joined Wang Sengbian to put down Hou Jing's rebellion.

links.text_zh: 徐陵入陈任尚书左仆射，草拟陈霸先受禅诏册。
links.text: Xu Ling served Chen Baxian and drafted the documents for his accession.

links.text_zh: 杨坚仕北周，随周武帝伐齐。
links.text: Yang Jian served Northern Zhou and joined Emperor Wu's war against Qi.

links.text_zh: 庾信羁留北周，仕周武帝任骠骑大将军。
links.text: Kept in the north, Yu Xin served Emperor Wu of Northern Zhou in high office.

links.text_zh: 斛律光与兰陵王高长恭同为北齐名将，并肩抗周。
links.text: Hulü Guang and Gao Changgong were Northern Qi's leading generals against the Zhou.

links.text_zh: 独孤皇后是李渊的姨母。
links.text: Empress Dugu was Li Yuan's maternal aunt.

links.text_zh: 杨坚娶独孤信之女独孤伽罗，誓无异生之子。
links.text: Yang Jian married Dugu Qieluo and vowed to have no children by other women.

check.n: Wikipedia dates the marriage to 557, when he was 16 and she 13.
check.n_zh: 维基百科记载二人于557年成婚，时杨坚16岁、独孤伽罗13岁。

links.text_zh: 独孤皇后宠爱次子杨广，助其夺嫡。
links.text: Empress Dugu favoured her son Yang Guang and helped him become heir.

links.text_zh: 李渊之母与独孤皇后为姊妹，与杨广为表兄弟。
links.text: Li Yuan's mother was Empress Dugu's sister, making him Yang Guang's cousin.

links.text_zh: 杨广为杨坚次子，604年继位为隋炀帝。
links.text: Yang Guang was Yang Jian's second son and became Emperor Yang in 604.

links.text_zh: 李靖是韩擒虎外甥，韩擒虎常与之论兵。
links.text: Li Jing was Han Qinhu's nephew, and Han often discussed warfare with him.

links.text_zh: 后主高纬听信谗言，诱杀斛律光。
links.text: Gao Wei believed slanders and had Hulü Guang killed.

links.text_zh: 颜之推仕北齐任黄门侍郎，得后主信任。
links.text: Yan Zhitui served Gao Wei's Northern Qi court as a palace official.

links.text_zh: 高纬忌兰陵王威名，赐毒酒令其自尽。
links.text: Fearing his fame, Gao Wei forced Gao Changgong to drink poison.

links.text_zh: 周武帝亲征平阳，大败北齐后主高纬。
links.text: Emperor Wu of Zhou personally defeated Gao Wei at Pingyang.

check.n: The source says Emperor Wu withdrew from Pingyang rather than engage Gao Wei's army, leaving Liang Shiyan in charge.
check.n_zh: 来源称周武帝闻齐军来援即撤兵，留梁士彦守平阳，并未亲自击败高纬。

links.text_zh: 高颎辅佐杨坚建隋，为开皇名相。
links.text: Gao Jiong helped Yang Jian found the Sui and was the leading minister of the Kaihuang era.

links.text_zh: 薛道衡仕隋文帝，掌机密诏诰。
links.text: Xue Daoheng served Emperor Wen drafting confidential edicts.

links.text_zh: 杨素为隋文帝重臣，平陈、击突厥立功。
links.text: Yang Su was a top minister and general of Emperor Wen of Sui.

links.text_zh: 薛道衡为《切韵序》所记八位论韵者之一。
links.text: Xue Daoheng was one of the eight scholars who discussed rhymes with Lu Fayan.

links.text_zh: 颜之推等八人在陆法言家论音韵，促成《切韵》。
links.text: Yan Zhitui and others discussed rhymes at Lu Fayan's home, inspiring the Qieyun.

links.text_zh: 宇文恺奉隋文帝之命规划营建大兴城。
links.text: Yuwen Kai planned the new capital Daxing for Emperor Wen.

links.text_zh: 灭陈后韩擒虎与贺若弼在御前争功。
links.text: After the conquest of Chen Han Qinhu and Heruo Bi quarrelled over credit before the emperor.

links.text_zh: 韩擒虎在晋王杨广统帅下率军攻入建康灭陈。
links.text: Han Qinhu, under supreme commander Yang Guang, stormed Jiankang and ended Chen.

links.text_zh: 韩擒虎奉隋文帝之命率军渡江，攻入建康。
links.text: Han Qinhu crossed the Yangtze for Emperor Wen and took Jiankang.

links.text_zh: 贺若弼随杨广伐陈，渡江破陈军。
links.text: Heruo Bi served in Yang Guang's campaign against Chen, crossing the Yangtze.

links.text_zh: 贺若弼献平陈策，为隋文帝渡江灭陈。
links.text: Heruo Bi devised the plan to conquer Chen and led it for Emperor Wen.

links.text_zh: 冼夫人率岭南归隋，被封谯国夫人。
links.text: Lady Xian brought Lingnan over to the Sui and was named Lady of Qiao.

links.text_zh: 智顗为晋王杨广授菩萨戒，杨广赐号“智者大师”。
links.text: Zhiyi gave Yang Guang the bodhisattva precepts and received the title Great Master Zhizhe.

links.text_zh: 吉藏致书敬请智顗讲《法华经》。
links.text: Jizang wrote to invite Zhiyi to lecture on the Lotus Sutra.

links.text_zh: 唐高祖李渊是唐太宗李世民之父。
links.text: Li Yuan was the father of Li Shimin.

links.text_zh: 独孤皇后怨恨高颎，屡进谗言致其罢相。
links.text: Empress Dugu resented Gao Jiong and had him removed from office.

check.n: The English article says she respected Gao Jiong, while the Chinese article says she was held to have contributed to his fall.
check.n_zh: 英文条目称独孤皇后敬重高颎，中文条目则称她被认为是高颎被废的原因之一，说法不一。

links.text_zh: 杨广迎吉藏入扬州慧日道场、长安日严寺。
links.text: Yang Guang installed Jizang in his temples at Yangzhou and Chang'an.

links.text_zh: 杨素助杨广构陷太子杨勇，助其夺嫡。
links.text: Yang Su helped Yang Guang bring down Crown Prince Yang Yong.

links.text_zh: 杨素作《赠薛播州》十四章赠好友薛道衡。
links.text: Yang Su wrote fourteen poems to his friend Xue Daoheng.

links.text_zh: 宇文恺为隋炀帝营建东都洛阳。
links.text: Yuwen Kai built the Eastern Capital Luoyang for Emperor Yang.

links.text_zh: 裴矩献《西域图记》，助隋炀帝经营西域。
links.text: Pei Ju presented his Western Regions atlas and managed western affairs for Emperor Yang.

links.text_zh: 隋炀帝以诽谤朝政罪诛杀高颎。
links.text: Emperor Yang executed Gao Jiong for criticising his government.

links.text_zh: 贺若弼议论朝政，被隋炀帝诛杀。
links.text: Heruo Bi was executed by Emperor Yang for criticising the court.

links.text_zh: 隋炀帝忌薛道衡才名，借故逼其自尽。
links.text: Jealous of his reputation, Emperor Yang forced Xue Daoheng to kill himself.

links.text_zh: 巢元方任太医博士，奉炀帝诏撰《诸病源候论》。
links.text: As imperial physician Chao Yuanfang compiled the Zhubing Yuanhou Lun by Emperor Yang's order.

links.text_zh: 王世充善迎合隋炀帝，受命镇守东都。
links.text: Wang Shichong won Emperor Yang's favour and was given command at Luoyang.

links.text_zh: 长孙皇后嫁李世民，贤德辅政。
links.text: Empress Zhangsun married Li Shimin and was a wise consort.

links.text_zh: 少年李世民应募救援被突厥围困雁门的隋炀帝。
links.text: Young Li Shimin joined the force relieving Emperor Yang at Yanmen.

check.n: The Chinese article says the Tang histories credit Li Shimin with the Yanmen rescue, but the Qiju zhu says Li Yuan did it, which most scholars follow.
check.n_zh: 中文条目称新旧唐书记李世民救驾，但《大唐创业起居注》记为李渊解围，学界多采后说。

links.text_zh: 房玄龄渭北投李世民，为其首席谋臣。
links.text: Fang Xuanling joined Li Shimin north of the Wei and became his chief strategist.

links.text_zh: 李密据洛口仓，传檄数炀帝十大罪。
links.text: Li Mi seized Luokou granary and issued a manifesto listing Emperor Yang's crimes.

links.text_zh: 徐世勣为李密部将，后携李密旧地归唐。
links.text: Xu Shiji served as Li Mi's general and later brought his lands over to Tang.

links.text_zh: 李渊起兵攻克长安，另立杨侑，遥尊炀帝为太上皇。
links.text: Li Yuan rose and took Chang'an, sidelining Emperor Yang.

links.text_zh: 魏征投瓦岗军，为李密掌书记。
links.text: Wei Zheng joined the Wagang army as Li Mi's secretary.

links.text_zh: 李靖归唐，受李渊之命南平萧铣。
links.text: Li Jing joined Tang and under Li Yuan conquered Xiao Xian in the south.

links.text_zh: 李密兵败后投奔李渊，旋又叛唐被杀。
links.text: After defeat Li Mi submitted to Li Yuan, then rebelled and was killed.

links.text_zh: 欧阳询早年为李渊宾客，入唐任给事中。
links.text: Ouyang Xun was Li Yuan's guest before Tang and then held office under him.

links.text_zh: 王世充于邙山大败李密，李密降唐。
links.text: Wang Shichong crushed Li Mi at Mount Mang, after which Li Mi surrendered to Tang.

links.text_zh: 窦建德率军援救被围的王世充。
links.text: Dou Jiande marched to relieve the besieged Wang Shichong.

links.text_zh: 李世民于虎牢关大破并生擒窦建德。
links.text: Li Shimin routed and captured Dou Jiande at Hulao Pass.

links.text_zh: 李世民围洛阳，逼王世充出降。
links.text: Li Shimin besieged Luoyang and forced Wang Shichong to surrender.

links.text_zh: 窦建德被俘送长安，为李渊所斩。
links.text: Captured Dou Jiande was sent to Chang'an and executed by Li Yuan.

links.text_zh: 欧阳询任弘文馆学士，以书法名于贞观。
links.text: Ouyang Xun served Taizong as a Hongwen Academy scholar and famed calligrapher.

links.text_zh: 魏征屡犯颜直谏，助成贞观之治。
links.text: Wei Zheng's blunt remonstrance helped shape the Zhenguan reign.

links.text_zh: 长孙皇后是唐高宗李治的生母。
links.text: Empress Zhangsun was Gaozong's mother.

links.text_zh: 唐高宗李治是唐太宗第九子。
links.text: Li Zhi (Gaozong) was Taizong's ninth son.

links.text_zh: 李靖奉唐太宗之命夜袭阴山，灭东突厥。
links.text: Li Jing, sent by Taizong, raided Yinshan and destroyed the Eastern Turks.

links.text_zh: 李勣与李靖分道出击，共破东突厥。
links.text: Li Shiji joined Li Jing's campaign that crushed the Eastern Turks for Taizong.

links.text_zh: 魏征撰文、欧阳询书丹成《九成宫醴泉铭》。
links.text: Wei Zheng composed and Ouyang Xun wrote out the Jiuchenggong Liquan Ming.

links.text_zh: 李淳风为唐太宗造浑天黄道仪，任太史令。
links.text: Li Chunfeng built an armillary sphere for Taizong and became astronomer royal.

links.text_zh: 武则天十四岁入宫为唐太宗才人。
links.text: At fourteen Wu Zetian entered Taizong's palace as a junior consort.

links.text_zh: 文成公主奉唐太宗之命远嫁吐蕃松赞干布。
links.text: Princess Wencheng was sent by Taizong to marry Songtsen Gampo of Tibet.

links.text_zh: 魏征卒，唐太宗亲撰碑文，叹失一镜。
links.text: When Wei Zheng died Taizong wrote his stele text, lamenting a lost mirror.

links.text_zh: 阎立本奉唐太宗命绘《凌烟阁功臣图》。
links.text: Yan Liben painted the Lingyan Pavilion portraits of meritorious officials for Taizong.

links.text_zh: 唐太宗为玄奘所译佛经撰《大唐三藏圣教序》。
links.text: Taizong wrote the Preface to the Holy Teaching for Xuanzang's translations.

links.text_zh: 唐高宗废王皇后，立武则天为皇后。
links.text: Gaozong deposed Empress Wang and made Wu Zetian empress.

links.text_zh: 唐高宗召见孙思邈，拜谏议大夫，固辞不受。
links.text: Gaozong summoned Sun Simiao and offered him office, which he declined.

links.text_zh: 太平公主是唐高宗与武则天的幼女。
links.text: Princess Taiping was the youngest daughter of Gaozong and Wu Zetian.

links.text_zh: 李淳风为唐高宗编成《麟德历》。
links.text: Li Chunfeng compiled the Linde calendar for Gaozong.

links.text_zh: 武则天极宠爱女儿太平公主。
links.text: Wu Zetian doted on her daughter Princess Taiping.

links.text_zh: 李勣受唐高宗之命统军灭高句丽。
links.text: Li Shiji led Gaozong's armies in the conquest of Goguryeo.

links.text_zh: 阎立本在唐高宗朝官至右相。
links.text: Yan Liben rose to Right Chancellor under Gaozong.

links.text_zh: 王勃作《檄英王鸡》，唐高宗怒而将其逐出沛王府。
links.text: Angered by Wang Bo's mock cockfight proclamation, Gaozong expelled him from Prince Pei's household.

links.text_zh: 上官婉儿受武则天赏识，掌宫中诏命。
links.text: Shangguan Wan'er won Wu Zetian's favour and drafted her edicts.

links.text_zh: 陈子昂上书武则天言事，擢为右拾遗。
links.text: Chen Zi'ang memorialised Wu Zetian and was made a Reminder.

links.text_zh: 太平公主是李隆基的姑母。
links.text: Princess Taiping was Li Longji's aunt.

links.text_zh: 唐玄宗李隆基是武则天之孙。
links.text: Li Longji (Xuanzong) was Wu Zetian's grandson.

links.text_zh: 狄仁杰为武则天宰相，备受敬重，称为国老。
links.text: Di Renjie served as Wu Zetian's chancellor, revered as the State Elder.

links.text_zh: 义净自印度归洛阳，武则天亲迎于上东门外。
links.text: When Yijing returned from India, Wu Zetian welcomed him outside Luoyang.

links.text_zh: 狄仁杰向武则天举荐姚崇等贤臣。
links.text: Di Renjie recommended Yao Chong and other able men to Wu Zetian.

links.text_zh: 姚崇在武周时期拜相。
links.text: Yao Chong became chancellor under Wu Zetian.

links.text_zh: 法藏为武则天讲华严，作《金狮子章》。
links.text: Fazang expounded Huayan to Wu Zetian with the Golden Lion essay.

links.text_zh: 刘知幾在武周朝任史官，参修国史。
links.text: Liu Zhiji served Wu Zetian's court as a historian.

links.text_zh: 唐隆政变中李隆基将上官婉儿斩于旗下。
links.text: In the Tanglong coup Li Longji had Shangguan Wan'er beheaded.

links.text_zh: 李隆基与太平公主联手发动唐隆政变，诛韦后。
links.text: Li Longji and Princess Taiping joined forces in the Tanglong coup against Empress Wei.

links.text_zh: 唐玄宗发动先天政变，赐死太平公主。
links.text: Xuanzong struck first in the Xiantian coup and forced Princess Taiping to die.

links.text_zh: 唐玄宗召吴道子入宫，任内教博士。
links.text: Xuanzong summoned Wu Daozi to court as a painting instructor.

links.text_zh: 姚崇上十事要说，辅唐玄宗开创开元之治。
links.text: Yao Chong's ten proposals launched Xuanzong's Kaiyuan prosperity.

links.text_zh: 吴道子早年学书于张旭。
links.text: Wu Daozi studied calligraphy under Zhang Xu.

links.text_zh: 一行奉唐玄宗之命改订历法，编成《大衍历》。
links.text: Yixing reformed the calendar for Xuanzong, producing the Dayan calendar.

links.text_zh: 刘晏八岁献颂，唐玄宗授以秘书省正字。
links.text: Eight-year-old Liu Yan presented an ode and Xuanzong gave him a post.

check.n: Evidence mentions Liu Yan received by Xuanzong at age ten, not eight.
check.n_zh: 文献提到玄宗接见的是十岁的刘晏，而非八岁。

links.text_zh: 王维与孟浩然交好，并称王孟。
links.text: Wang Wei and Meng Haoran were close friends, paired as Wang-Meng.

links.text_zh: 七岁李泌以神童受唐玄宗召见。
links.text: Aged seven, Li Mi was received by Xuanzong as a prodigy.

links.text_zh: 张九龄赏识神童李泌，呼为小友。
links.text: Zhang Jiuling admired the child prodigy Li Mi and called him his little friend.

links.text_zh: 李白作《黄鹤楼送孟浩然之广陵》。
links.text: Li Bai wrote 'Seeing Meng Haoran off to Guangling at Yellow Crane Tower'.

links.text_zh: 张萱在开元年间为宫廷画家，擅绘仕女。
links.text: Zhang Xuan was a Kaiyuan court painter of palace ladies.

links.text_zh: 孟浩然作《望洞庭湖赠张丞相》投赠张九龄。
links.text: Meng Haoran wrote 'Gazing at Dongting Lake, for Chancellor Zhang' to Zhang Jiuling.

links.text_zh: 张九龄为唐玄宗贤相，后为李林甫所排罢相。
links.text: Zhang Jiuling was Xuanzong's upright chancellor until ousted by Li Linfu.

links.text_zh: 王维作《献始兴公》呈张九龄，求引荐。
links.text: Wang Wei presented 'To the Duke of Shixing' to Zhang Jiuling.

links.text_zh: 张九龄断言安禄山必反，奏请诛之，玄宗不许。
links.text: Zhang Jiuling foresaw An Lushan's rebellion and urged his execution, in vain.

links.text_zh: 孟浩然入荆州长史张九龄幕府。
links.text: Meng Haoran joined Zhang Jiuling's staff at Jingzhou.

links.text_zh: 王昌龄访孟浩然，相聚欢饮，孟浩然不久病卒。
links.text: Wang Changling visited Meng Haoran; Meng died soon after their feast.

links.text_zh: 安禄山得唐玄宗宠信，身兼三镇节度使。
links.text: An Lushan won Xuanzong's trust and held three military governorships.

links.text_zh: 唐德宗李适是唐玄宗的曾孙。
links.text: Li Kuo (Dezong) was Xuanzong's great-grandson.

links.text_zh: 李白受唐玄宗征召，供奉翰林。
links.text: Li Bai was summoned by Xuanzong to serve in the Hanlin Academy.

links.text_zh: 颜真卿向张旭请教笔法。
links.text: Yan Zhenqing studied brush technique with Zhang Xu.

links.text_zh: 李白奉诏为杨贵妃作《清平调》三首。
links.text: Li Bai wrote the three 'Qingping Songs' about Yang Guifei by imperial order.

links.text_zh: 杜甫与高适结交于梁宋，晚年在蜀中仍相互扶持。
links.text: Du Fu and Gao Shi became friends in 744 and stayed close in Sichuan.

links.text_zh: 李白与杜甫在洛阳相遇，同游梁宋。
links.text: Li Bai and Du Fu met at Luoyang and travelled together.

links.text_zh: 李白与高适、杜甫同游梁宋，登台怀古。
links.text: Li Bai roamed Liang and Song with Gao Shi and Du Fu.
