links.text_zh: 唐玄宗册封杨玉环为贵妃，马嵬驿之变中被迫赐死。
links.text: Xuanzong made Yang Yuhuan his consort, then had to let her die at Mawei.

links.text_zh: 不空在长安为唐玄宗灌顶，弘传密宗。
links.text: Amoghavajra gave Xuanzong esoteric consecration in Chang'an.

links.text_zh: 杜甫作《春日忆李白》，称其诗无敌。
links.text: Du Fu wrote 'Remembering Li Bai on a Spring Day', praising his peerless verse.

links.text_zh: 杜甫《饮中八仙歌》写张旭“脱帽露顶王公前”。
links.text: Du Fu's 'Eight Immortals of the Wine Cup' portrays Zhang Xu.

links.text_zh: 安禄山请为杨贵妃养子，出入宫禁。
links.text: An Lushan had himself adopted as Yang Guifei's son and roamed the palace.

links.text_zh: 李白作《闻王昌龄左迁龙标遥有此寄》。
links.text: Li Bai wrote a poem on hearing Wang Changling was demoted to Longbiao.

links.text_zh: 岑参入安西节度使高仙芝幕府任掌书记。
links.text: Cen Shen served as secretary on Gao Xianzhi's staff in Anxi.

links.text_zh: 岑参与杜甫、高适等同登慈恩寺塔赋诗。
links.text: Cen Shen climbed the Ci'en Pagoda with Du Fu and Gao Shi, writing poems.

check.n: Wikipedia names Gao Shi and Xue Ju (not Du Fu) as Cen Shen's companions on the pagoda poem; Du Fu is only said to have befriended him around 751.
check.n_zh: 维基称岑参登慈恩寺塔诗的同游者为高适、薛据，未提杜甫；杜甫仅被说于约751年与其结交。

links.text_zh: 高适与岑参同登慈恩寺塔唱和，并称高岑。
links.text: Gao Shi and Cen Shen wrote poems together at the Ci'en Pagoda.

links.text_zh: 唐玄宗听信监军谗言，斩高仙芝于潼关。
links.text: Believing a eunuch's slander, Xuanzong had Gao Xianzhi executed at Tongguan.

links.text_zh: 高仙芝率军抵御安禄山叛军，退守潼关。
links.text: Gao Xianzhi faced An Lushan's army and fell back to Tongguan.

links.text_zh: 郭子仪率朔方军讨伐安禄山叛军。
links.text: Guo Ziyi led the Shuofang army against An Lushan's rebels.

links.text_zh: 颜真卿在平原起兵抵抗安禄山。
links.text: Yan Zhenqing raised troops at Pingyuan to resist An Lushan.

links.text_zh: 郭子仪荐李光弼，二人并称郭李，共平安史之乱。
links.text: Guo Ziyi recommended Li Guangbi; together they fought the An-Shi rebellion.

links.text_zh: 安禄山陷长安，王维被俘，被迫受伪职。
links.text: When An Lushan took Chang'an, Wang Wei was captured and forced to take office.

links.text_zh: 岑参作《寄左省杜拾遗》赠杜甫。
links.text: Cen Shen wrote 'To Reminder Du of the Left Chancellery' for Du Fu.

links.text_zh: 高适作《人日寄杜二拾遗》寄成都杜甫。
links.text: Gao Shi sent 'On Renri, to Du Fu' to Du Fu in Chengdu.

links.text_zh: 颜真卿为怀素作《怀素上人草书歌序》。
links.text: Yan Zhenqing wrote a preface on Huaisu's cursive script for him.

links.text_zh: 陆羽在湖州参与颜真卿主持编修《韵海镜源》。
links.text: Lu Yu helped Yan Zhenqing compile the Yunhai Jingyuan at Huzhou.

links.text_zh: 唐德宗即位，尊郭子仪为尚父。
links.text: Dezong honoured Guo Ziyi as Shangfu on his accession.

links.text_zh: 唐德宗听信杨炎，贬杀理财名臣刘晏。
links.text: Swayed by Yang Yan, Dezong had the finance minister Liu Yan put to death.

links.text_zh: 陆羽为书僧怀素作《僧怀素传》。
links.text: Lu Yu wrote the 'Biography of the Monk Huaisu'.

links.text_zh: 颜真卿奉唐德宗命宣慰李希烈，被扣遇害。
links.text: Sent by Dezong to negotiate with Li Xilie, Yan Zhenqing was held and killed.

links.text_zh: 李泌在唐德宗朝拜相，调和君臣、安定边事。
links.text: Li Mi became Dezong's chancellor and steadied court and frontier.

links.text_zh: 贾耽在唐德宗朝拜相，精研地理。
links.text: Jia Dan, a great geographer, became Dezong's chancellor.

links.text_zh: 柳宗元与刘禹锡同榜进士，同遭贬谪，并称刘柳。
links.text: Liu Zongyuan and Liu Yuxi passed the exam together and were exiled together.

links.text_zh: 杜佑撰成《通典》进献唐德宗。
links.text: Du You presented his Tongdian to Emperor Dezong.

links.text_zh: 白居易与元稹同登科，终生唱和，并称元白。
links.text: Bai Juyi and Yuan Zhen passed the exam together and exchanged poems for life.

links.text_zh: 杜牧是宰相杜佑之孙。
links.text: Du Mu was the grandson of chancellor Du You.

links.text_zh: 韩愈与柳宗元共倡古文运动，并称韩柳。
links.text: Han Yu and Liu Zongyuan led the classical prose movement together.

links.text_zh: 韩愈为李贺应举避讳之事作《讳辩》。
links.text: Han Yu wrote 'On Taboo Names' defending Li He's right to sit the exam.

links.text_zh: 元稹出使蜀中，与女诗人薛涛结识唱和。
links.text: On a mission to Sichuan, Yuan Zhen met and exchanged poems with Xue Tao.

links.text_zh: 元稹作《闻乐天授江州司马》。
links.text: Yuan Zhen wrote a poem on hearing Bai Juyi was demoted to Jiangzhou.

links.text_zh: 柳宗元卒，韩愈作《柳子厚墓志铭》。
links.text: After Liu Zongyuan died Han Yu wrote his epitaph.

links.text_zh: 元稹与李德裕、李绅同为翰林学士，号三俊。
links.text: Yuan Zhen, Li Deyu and Li Shen were Hanlin colleagues called the Three Talents.

links.text_zh: 韩愈卒，刘禹锡作《祭韩吏部文》。
links.text: When Han Yu died Liu Yuxi wrote a eulogy for him.

links.text_zh: 白居易作《醉赠刘二十八使君》，刘禹锡酬以“沉舟侧畔千帆过”。
links.text: Bai Juyi wrote a poem for Liu Yuxi, who replied with his famous 'sunken boat' lines.

links.text_zh: 刘禹锡与李德裕诗书往还，结集为《吴蜀集》。
links.text: Liu Yuxi and Li Deyu exchanged poems, collected as the Wu-Shu Ji.

links.text_zh: 杜牧上书李德裕，献平泽潞用兵之策。
links.text: Du Mu wrote to Li Deyu proposing strategy against Zelu.

links.text_zh: 白居易卒，李商隐为其撰写墓碑铭。
links.text: After Bai Juyi died Li Shangyin wrote his tomb inscription.

links.text_zh: 李商隐为李德裕文集作《会昌一品集序》。
links.text: Li Shangyin wrote the preface to Li Deyu's collected works.

links.text_zh: 李商隐作《杜司勋》赠杜牧。
links.text: Li Shangyin wrote 'Du of the Merit Bureau' for Du Mu.

links.text_zh: 李商隐与温庭筠诗风相近，互有唱和，并称温李。
links.text: Li Shangyin and Wen Tingyun exchanged poems and were paired as Wen-Li.

links.text_zh: 朱温投黄巢起义军为大将，后降唐。
links.text: Zhu Wen became a general in Huang Chao's army before defecting to Tang.

links.text_zh: 李嗣源为李克用养子，以骁勇著称。
links.text: Li Siyuan was Li Keyong's adopted son and a fierce general.

links.text_zh: 李克用率沙陀军大败黄巢，收复长安。
links.text: Li Keyong's Shatuo army routed Huang Chao and retook Chang'an.

links.text_zh: 朱温在上源驿设伏欲杀李克用，二人结为世仇。
links.text: Zhu Wen ambushed Li Keyong at Shangyuan Inn, starting a lifelong feud.

links.text_zh: 李存勖是晋王李克用长子，继承父志灭梁。
links.text: Li Cunxu was Li Keyong's son and fulfilled his vow to destroy Liang.

links.text_zh: 韦庄入蜀为王建掌书记，助其建立前蜀并任宰相。
links.text: Wei Zhuang joined Wang Jian and became chancellor of Former Shu.

links.text_zh: 辽太宗耶律德光是阿保机次子。
links.text: Yelü Deguang was Abaoji's second son.

links.text_zh: 贯休作《献钱尚父》，有“一剑霜寒十四州”之句。
links.text: Guanxiu presented a poem to Qian Liu with the line about fourteen prefectures.

links.text_zh: 贯休入蜀，王建礼遇之，赐号禅月大师。
links.text: Guanxiu went to Shu, where Wang Jian named him Great Master Chanyue.

links.text_zh: 李克用与耶律阿保机会于云州，约为兄弟。
links.text: Li Keyong and Abaoji met at Yunzhou and swore brotherhood.

links.text_zh: 杜光庭入蜀事王建，受封传真天师。
links.text: Du Guangting served Wang Jian of Former Shu and was honoured as Celestial Master.

links.text_zh: 朱温建后梁，封钱镠为吴越王。
links.text: Zhu Wen founded Later Liang and named Qian Liu King of Wuyue.

links.text_zh: 朱温篡唐，王建拒不承认，自立为帝。
links.text: When Zhu Wen usurped Tang, Wang Jian refused to recognise him and took the throne.

links.text_zh: 李存勖解潞州之围，大败梁军。
links.text: Li Cunxu broke Zhu Wen's siege of Luzhou.

links.text_zh: 后梁太祖朱温封王审知为闽王。
links.text: Zhu Wen enfeoffed Wang Shenzhi as King of Min.

links.text_zh: 石敬瑭娶李嗣源之女，为其女婿。
links.text: Shi Jingtang married Li Siyuan's daughter.

links.text_zh: 柴荣是郭威妻侄，被收为养子并继位。
links.text: Chai Rong, nephew of Guo Wei's wife, was adopted as his heir.

links.text_zh: 李存勖在望都击退阿保机的契丹军。
links.text: Li Cunxu drove back Abaoji's Khitan army at Wangdu.

links.text_zh: 李嗣源为李存勖前锋，奇袭汴梁灭后梁。
links.text: Li Siyuan led Li Cunxu's vanguard in the surprise attack that ended Later Liang.

links.text_zh: 兴教门之变中庄宗遇害，李嗣源入洛即位。
links.text: After Zhuangzong was killed in a mutiny, Li Siyuan took the throne.

links.text_zh: 刘昫在后唐明宗朝任翰林学士。
links.text: Liu Xu served Mingzong of Later Tang as a Hanlin scholar.

links.text_zh: 冯道为后唐明宗宰相，奏请国子监雕印九经。
links.text: Feng Dao, Mingzong's chancellor, had the Nine Classics printed.

links.text_zh: 石敬瑭称儿皇帝，割燕云十六州换取耶律德光扶立。
links.text: Shi Jingtang became Yelü Deguang's 'son emperor', ceding the Sixteen Prefectures.

links.text_zh: 冯道为后晋宰相，奉命出使契丹行册礼。
links.text: Feng Dao served Shi Jingtang as chancellor and envoy to the Khitan.

links.text_zh: 赵光义是宋太祖赵匡胤之弟。
links.text: Zhao Guangyi was Zhao Kuangyin's younger brother.

links.text_zh: 和凝在后晋高祖朝拜相。
links.text: He Ning became chancellor under Shi Jingtang.

links.text_zh: 董源仕南唐中主，任北苑副使。
links.text: Dong Yuan served Li Jing as deputy of the Northern Park.

links.text_zh: 冯延巳为南唐中主李璟宰相，君臣以词唱和。
links.text: Feng Yansi was Li Jing's chancellor; they traded ci lyrics.

links.text_zh: 韩熙载自北方投南唐，仕于中主李璟。
links.text: Han Xizai, a northern émigré, served Li Jing of Southern Tang.

links.text_zh: 耶律德光入汴，冯道往朝见，被授太傅。
links.text: When Deguang took Kaifeng, Feng Dao paid court and was made Grand Tutor.

links.text_zh: 赵匡胤投郭威帐下从军。
links.text: Zhao Kuangyin joined Guo Wei's army.

links.text_zh: 郭威建后周，冯道仍居太师高位。
links.text: Feng Dao kept high office as Grand Preceptor under Guo Wei.

links.text_zh: 冯道力谏柴荣勿亲征北汉，世宗不听，取胜高平。
links.text: Feng Dao opposed Chai Rong's campaign; Chai Rong went and won at Gaoping.

links.text_zh: 赵匡胤在高平之战中奋勇破敌，受柴荣重用。
links.text: Zhao Kuangyin fought bravely at Gaoping and was promoted by Chai Rong.

links.text_zh: 柴荣亲征淮南，大败南唐。
links.text: Chai Rong personally campaigned in Huainan against Southern Tang.

links.text_zh: 周世宗召陈抟入宫问道，欲授官，坚辞。
links.text: Chai Rong summoned Chen Tuan and offered office, which he refused.

links.text_zh: 李璟割江北十四州，去帝号向后周称臣。
links.text: Li Jing ceded fourteen prefectures and submitted to Later Zhou.

links.text_zh: 赵普策划陈桥兵变，拥立赵匡胤。
links.text: Zhao Pu planned the Chenqiao mutiny that put Zhao Kuangyin on the throne.

links.text_zh: 后蜀亡，黄筌随孟昶入宋，任太子左赞善大夫。
links.text: After Later Shu fell, Huang Quan went to Song and took office under Taizu.

links.text_zh: 宋真宗赵恒是宋太宗赵光义之子。
links.text: Emperor Zhenzong was the son of Emperor Taizong Zhao Guangyi.

links.text_zh: 李昉奉宋太宗之命主编《太平御览》等书。
links.text: Li Fang compiled the Taiping Yulan for Song Taizong.

links.text_zh: 北汉亡，杨业归宋，宋太宗命其镇守代州。
links.text: After Northern Han fell, Yang Ye joined Song and guarded Daizhou for Taizong.

links.text_zh: 高梁河之战，耶律休哥大败宋太宗所率宋军。
links.text: At the Gaoliang River, Yelü Xiuge routed the Song army led by Emperor Taizong.

links.text_zh: 赵普在宋太宗朝再度拜相。
links.text: Zhao Pu became chancellor again under Zhao Guangyi.

links.text_zh: 耶律休哥受承天太后萧绰重用，总领南面军务。
links.text: Yelü Xiuge served Empress Dowager Xiao Chuo as commander of Liao's southern front.

links.text_zh: 宋太宗召见陈抟，赐号希夷先生。
links.text: Song Taizong received Chen Tuan and named him Master Xiyi.

links.text_zh: 雍熙北伐中萧太后亲督辽军，杨业兵败被俘殉国。
links.text: With Empress Xiao leading Liao, Yang Ye was defeated, captured and died.

check.n: Chinese article dates Yang Ye's capture to Song's 986 campaign, but the English article places his death in a 989 invasion.
check.n_zh: 中文条目称杨业于986年北伐中被俘，英文条目则称其死于989年的宋军入侵，来源不一。

links.text_zh: 寇准直言敢谏，太宗称得寇准如唐太宗得魏征。
links.text: Kou Zhun's blunt counsel led Taizong to compare him to Wei Zheng.

links.text_zh: 寇准力劝宋真宗亲征澶州，促成澶渊之盟。
links.text: Kou Zhun persuaded Emperor Zhenzong to lead the army to Chanzhou, leading to the Chanyuan Treaty.

links.text_zh: 宋真宗亲征澶州抵御萧绰，双方订立澶渊之盟。
links.text: Emperor Zhenzong met Xiao Chuo's invasion at Chanzhou and the two sealed the Chanyuan Treaty.

links.text_zh: 宋仁宗赵祯是宋真宗之子。
links.text: Emperor Renzong was the son of Emperor Zhenzong.

links.text_zh: 梅尧臣早年在杭州结识隐士林逋，后为其诗集作序。
links.text: Mei Yaochen met the recluse Lin Bu in Hangzhou and later prefaced his poems.

links.text_zh: 范仲淹作《寄赠林逋处士》诗，敬仰其隐逸。
links.text: Fan Zhongyan wrote a poem to the recluse Lin Bu admiring his life.

links.text_zh: 王惟一奉宋仁宗之命铸造针灸铜人。
links.text: Wang Weiyi cast bronze acupuncture figures for Emperor Renzong.

links.text_zh: 晏殊举荐范仲淹，范终身以门生自居。
links.text: Yan Shu recommended Fan Zhongyan, who regarded himself as Yan's protégé.

links.text_zh: 晏殊主持礼部考试，欧阳修由此登第。
links.text: Yan Shu presided over the examination in which Ouyang Xiu passed.

links.text_zh: 梅尧臣与欧阳修在洛阳结交，终生唱和。
links.text: Mei Yaochen and Ouyang Xiu became friends in Luoyang and exchanged poems for life.

links.text_zh: 张载是程颢、程颐兄弟的表叔。
links.text: Zhang Zai was a maternal uncle of the Cheng brothers.

links.text_zh: 程颢、程颐兄弟并称“二程”，在洛阳讲学。
links.text: Cheng Hao and Cheng Yi, the Two Chengs, taught together in Luoyang.

links.text_zh: 柳永屡试不第，至仁宗景祐元年方登进士。
links.text: After repeated failures, Liu Yong passed the jinshi exam under Renzong in 1034.

links.text_zh: 范仲淹被贬，蔡襄作《四贤一不肖》诗称颂他。
links.text: When Fan Zhongyan was exiled, Cai Xiang praised him in Four Worthies and One Unworthy.

links.text_zh: 范仲淹遭贬，欧阳修致书高若讷为其鸣不平，同被贬谪。
links.text: When Fan Zhongyan was demoted, Ouyang Xiu defended him and was demoted too.

links.text_zh: 苏洵是苏轼之父，父子同列唐宋八大家。
links.text: Su Xun was the father of Su Shi; both are among the Eight Masters.

links.text_zh: 狄青在宋夏战争中屡破西夏军，以骁勇闻名。
links.text: Di Qing won fame fighting Li Yuanhao's Western Xia armies.

links.text_zh: 苏轼与苏辙为兄弟，手足情深。
links.text: Su Shi and Su Zhe were brothers with a deep lifelong bond.

links.text_zh: 苏洵是苏辙之父，世称“三苏”。
links.text: Su Xun was the father of Su Zhe; together with Su Shi they are the Three Sus.

links.text_zh: 范仲淹授狄青《左氏春秋》，勉其通晓古今兵法。
links.text: Fan Zhongyan gave Di Qing the Zuo Commentary and urged him to study history.

links.text_zh: 范仲淹经略陕西，固守边防抵御李元昊。
links.text: Fan Zhongyan commanded the Shaanxi frontier against Li Yuanhao's Western Xia.

links.text_zh: 范仲淹劝青年张载读《中庸》，引他走上儒学之路。
links.text: Fan Zhongyan urged the young Zhang Zai to read the Doctrine of the Mean, turning him to Confucian learning.

links.text_zh: 曾巩投书欧阳修，受其赏识而列门下。
links.text: Zeng Gong wrote to Ouyang Xiu and became his student.

links.text_zh: 沈括在《梦溪笔谈》中记载毕昇发明活字印刷术。
links.text: Shen Kuo recorded Bi Sheng's movable type in his Dream Pool Essays.

links.text_zh: 曾巩与王安石为同乡好友，曾向欧阳修推荐王安石。
links.text: Zeng Gong, a friend from the same region, recommended Wang Anshi to Ouyang Xiu.

links.text_zh: 张先曾在晏殊幕下任通判，深得赏识。
links.text: Zhang Xian served as an assistant prefect under Yan Shu, who valued him.

links.text_zh: 范仲淹受宋仁宗任为参知政事，推行庆历新政。
links.text: Fan Zhongyan led the Qingli Reforms as vice chancellor under Emperor Renzong.

links.text_zh: 欧阳修任谏官，在仁宗朝支持庆历新政。
links.text: Ouyang Xiu served Renzong as a remonstrance official backing the Qingli Reforms.

links.text_zh: 李元昊与宋仁宗订庆历和议，西夏名义称臣。
links.text: Li Yuanhao concluded the Qingli Peace with Renzong, nominally submitting to Song.

links.text_zh: 曾公亮奉宋仁宗之命主编《武经总要》。
links.text: Zeng Gongliang compiled the Wujing Zongyao on Renzong's orders.

links.text_zh: 少年程颢受学于周敦颐。
links.text: The young Cheng Hao studied under Zhou Dunyi.

links.text_zh: 程颐与兄程颢一同受学于周敦颐。
links.text: Cheng Yi studied under Zhou Dunyi together with his brother.

links.text_zh: 狄青受宋仁宗之命南征侬智高，后官至枢密使。
links.text: Di Qing crushed Nong Zhigao for Renzong and became Military Affairs Commissioner.

links.text_zh: 包拯受宋仁宗任为开封知府，以清廉刚正著称。
links.text: Bao Zheng served Renzong as prefect of Kaifeng, famed for integrity.

links.text_zh: 欧阳修上疏弹劾武将狄青，狄青遂罢枢密使。
links.text: Ouyang Xiu memorialised against Di Qing, who was removed from office.

links.text_zh: 欧阳修作《赠王介甫》诗，称赏王安石之才。
links.text: Ouyang Xiu praised Wang Anshi's talent in the poem To Wang Jiefu.

links.text_zh: 欧阳修读苏洵文章大加赞赏，上书荐之于朝。
links.text: Ouyang Xiu admired Su Xun's essays and recommended him to court.

links.text_zh: 张载在开封与二程讨论《易》学，自认不及。
links.text: Zhang Zai discussed the Book of Changes with the Chengs in Kaifeng.

links.text_zh: 梅尧臣任考官时推荐苏轼的试卷给欧阳修。
links.text: As an examiner, Mei Yaochen brought Su Shi's paper to Ouyang Xiu's attention.

links.text_zh: 欧阳修主考，录取苏轼并称“当让此人出一头地”。
links.text: Ouyang Xiu passed Su Shi in the 1057 exam, predicting he would surpass him.

links.text_zh: 苏辙在欧阳修主持的考试中与兄同榜进士。
links.text: Su Zhe passed the 1057 exam presided over by Ouyang Xiu alongside his brother.

links.text_zh: 王安石向仁宗呈《上仁宗皇帝言事书》，力主变法。
links.text: Wang Anshi sent Renzong his Myriad-Word Memorial calling for reform.

links.text_zh: 欧阳修为好友蔡襄撰写墓志铭。
links.text: Ouyang Xiu wrote the epitaph of his friend Cai Xiang.

links.text_zh: 宋神宗为司马光所编史书赐名《资治通鉴》并作序。
links.text: Emperor Shenzong named Sima Guang's history the Zizhi Tongjian and wrote its preface.

links.text_zh: 曾公亮向宋神宗举荐王安石。
links.text: Zeng Gongliang recommended Wang Anshi to Emperor Shenzong.

links.text_zh: 郭熙深得宋神宗赏识，宫中殿壁多出其手。
links.text: Guo Xi was Shenzong's favourite painter, decorating palace halls.

links.text_zh: 司马光反对王安石变法，两人成为新旧党领袖。
links.text: Sima Guang opposed Wang Anshi's reforms; they led the rival factions.

links.text_zh: 宋神宗起用王安石为相，推行熙宁变法。
links.text: Emperor Shenzong made Wang Anshi chancellor to carry out the New Policies.

links.text_zh: 邵雍与程颢同在洛阳，相与论学。
links.text: Shao Yong and Cheng Hao discussed learning together in Luoyang.

links.text_zh: 苏辙曾入制置三司条例司，因反对新法而离去。
links.text: Su Zhe joined the reform bureau but left after opposing Wang Anshi's policies.

links.text_zh: 司马光退居洛阳，与邵雍往来密切。
links.text: Sima Guang lived in Luoyang and was a close friend of Shao Yong.

links.text_zh: 苏轼上书反对新法，与王安石政见相左。
links.text: Su Shi memorialised against the New Policies, opposing Wang Anshi.

links.text_zh: 沈括支持王安石变法，受命主持司天监等事务。
links.text: Shen Kuo supported Wang Anshi's reforms and ran the Astronomical Bureau.

links.text_zh: 王韶献《平戎策》，奉宋神宗之命开拓熙河。
links.text: Wang Shao presented his frontier strategy and conquered Xihe for Shenzong.

links.text_zh: 苏轼作诗戏赠年逾八旬仍纳妾的张先。
links.text: Su Shi wrote a teasing poem for the elderly Zhang Xian.

links.text_zh: 沈括奉宋神宗之命出使辽国，据理争回边界。
links.text: Shen Kuo was sent by Shenzong as envoy to Liao and won a border dispute.

links.text_zh: 苏轼中秋作《水调歌头·明月几时有》，兼怀弟苏辙。
links.text: Su Shi wrote the Mid-Autumn lyric 'When Will the Moon Be Bright' thinking of Su Zhe.

links.text_zh: 黄庭坚致书苏轼，后为“苏门四学士”之一。
links.text: Huang Tingjian wrote to Su Shi and became one of his Four Scholars.

links.text_zh: 秦观拜见苏轼，成为“苏门四学士”之一。
links.text: Qin Guan met Su Shi and became one of his Four Scholars.

links.text_zh: 乌台诗案中苏轼下狱，宋神宗从轻贬其至黄州。
links.text: In the Crow Terrace case Su Shi was jailed; Shenzong spared him and exiled him to Huangzhou.

links.text_zh: 苏轼作《文与可画筼筜谷偃竹记》，记表兄文同画竹。
links.text: Su Shi wrote an essay on his cousin Wen Tong's bamboo painting.

links.text_zh: 乌台诗案时苏颂同囚御史台，作诗怀苏轼。
links.text: Su Song, jailed at the same time, wrote poems about Su Shi.

links.text_zh: 钱乙治愈皇子之病，受宋神宗授翰林医学。
links.text: Qian Yi cured an imperial prince and was appointed court physician by Shenzong.

links.text_zh: 宋徽宗赵佶是宋神宗之子。
links.text: Emperor Huizong was a son of Emperor Shenzong.

links.text_zh: 米芾到黄州拜访苏轼，得其指点书画。
links.text: Mi Fu visited Su Shi in Huangzhou and received advice on art.

links.text_zh: 苏轼过金陵拜访退隐的王安石，二人唱和尽欢。
links.text: Su Shi visited the retired Wang Anshi in Jinling and they exchanged poems.

links.text_zh: 黄庭坚与秦观同列苏门四学士，诗词唱和。
links.text: Huang Tingjian and Qin Guan, fellow Su disciples, exchanged poems.

links.text_zh: 程颐与苏轼不和，形成洛党、蜀党之争。
links.text: Cheng Yi and Su Shi clashed, splitting into the Luo and Shu factions.

links.text_zh: 司马光举荐程颐为崇政殿说书。
links.text: Sima Guang recommended Cheng Yi as imperial lecturer.

links.text_zh: 苏轼作《郭熙画秋山平远》诗题郭熙画作。
links.text: Su Shi wrote a poem on Guo Xi's painting of autumn hills.

links.text_zh: 李公麟与苏轼等人有“西园雅集”，并为苏轼画像。
links.text: Li Gonglin joined Su Shi's Western Garden gathering and painted his portrait.

links.text_zh: 宋徽宗禅位于长子宋钦宗。
links.text: Huizong abdicated in favour of his eldest son Qinzong.

check.n: Wikipedia says Huizong abdicated to Qinzong in January 1126; 1100 is Qinzong's birth year.
check.n_zh: 据维基百科，徽宗于1126年禅位于钦宗；1100年是钦宗出生之年。

links.text_zh: 蔡京受宋徽宗重用为相，立元祐党籍碑。
links.text: Cai Jing became Huizong's chancellor and erected the Yuanyou faction stele.

links.text_zh: 李诫编修的《营造法式》在徽宗朝颁行。
links.text: Li Jie's building manual Yingzao Fashi was issued under Huizong.

links.text_zh: 米芾被宋徽宗召为书画学博士。
links.text: Mi Fu was appointed Erudite of Calligraphy and Painting by Huizong.

links.text_zh: 宋高宗赵构是宋徽宗第九子。
links.text: Emperor Gaozong was Huizong's ninth son.

links.text_zh: 宋钦宗是宋高宗之兄，靖康之变被金人掳去。
links.text: Qinzong, Gaozong's elder brother, was captured by the Jin at Jingkang.

links.text_zh: 张择端为翰林画师，绘《清明上河图》，徽宗题签。
links.text: Court painter Zhang Zeduan painted Along the River, bearing Huizong's label.

links.text_zh: 蔡京为王希孟《千里江山图》题跋，记其身世。
links.text: Cai Jing wrote the colophon on Wang Ximeng's Thousand Li scroll.

links.text_zh: 宋徽宗亲授王希孟画法，王遂成《千里江山图》。
links.text: Huizong personally taught Wang Ximeng, who painted A Thousand Li of Rivers and Mountains.

links.text_zh: 护步达冈之战，完颜阿骨打大败辽天祚帝亲征大军。
links.text: At Hubudagang, Aguda crushed the army led by Emperor Tianzuo.

links.text_zh: 完颜宗弼（金兀术）是完颜阿骨打第四子。
links.text: Wanyan Zongbi (Wuzhu) was Aguda's fourth son.

links.text_zh: 周邦彦在徽宗朝提举大晟府，掌管乐律。
links.text: Zhou Bangyan headed Huizong's Dasheng music bureau.

links.text_zh: 方腊因花石纲之苦起义反抗宋徽宗。
links.text: Fang La rebelled against Huizong's oppressive rule.

links.text_zh: 李唐在徽宗朝考入画院，为宫廷画家。
links.text: Li Tang entered Huizong's painting academy.

links.text_zh: 宋徽宗与完颜阿骨打订立海上之盟，联手灭辽。
links.text: Huizong and Aguda made the Alliance at Sea against Liao.

links.text_zh: 韩世忠参与镇压方腊，在帮源洞擒获方腊。
links.text: Han Shizhong helped crush Fang La and captured him at Bangyuan cave.

links.text_zh: 梁红玉是韩世忠之妻，夫妇同抗金兵。
links.text: Liang Hongyu was Han Shizhong's wife; they fought the Jin together.

links.text_zh: 金军围开封，李纲受宋钦宗任命主持东京防御。
links.text: Li Gang directed Kaifeng's defence for Qinzong during the Jin siege.

links.text_zh: 李纲举荐宗泽为东京留守。
links.text: Li Gang recommended Zong Ze as governor of the Eastern Capital.

links.text_zh: 岳飞在宗泽麾下作战，受其赏识提拔。
links.text: Yue Fei fought under Zong Ze, who promoted him.

links.text_zh: 宗泽留守东京，二十余次上书请宋高宗还都。
links.text: Zong Ze held Kaifeng and petitioned Gaozong over twenty times to return.

links.text_zh: 李唐南渡后在高宗朝复入画院，授待诏。
links.text: Li Tang rejoined the painting academy under Gaozong after fleeing south.

links.text_zh: 韩世忠平定苗刘兵变，救出宋高宗。
links.text: Han Shizhong suppressed the Miao-Liu mutiny and restored Gaozong.

links.text_zh: 黄天荡之战，韩世忠以八千水军困金兀术四十八日。
links.text: At Huangtiandang Han Shizhong trapped Wuzhu's army for 48 days.

links.text_zh: 黄天荡之战中梁红玉亲自擂鼓助战。
links.text: Liang Hongyu beat the war drums against Wuzhu at Huangtiandang.

links.text_zh: 金兀术“搜山检海”追击宋高宗，高宗逃至海上。
links.text: Wuzhu hunted Gaozong, who fled out to sea.

links.text_zh: 和尚原之战，吴玠大败金兀术。
links.text: Wu Jie routed Wuzhu at Heshangyuan.

links.text_zh: 宋高宗亲书“精忠岳飞”锦旗赐给岳飞。
links.text: Gaozong gave Yue Fei a banner inscribed 'Utterly Loyal Yue Fei'.

links.text_zh: 秦桧受宋高宗任为宰相，主持对金议和。
links.text: Qin Hui became Gaozong's chancellor and pursued peace with Jin.

links.text_zh: 郾城大捷，岳飞击败金兀术的拐子马。
links.text: At Yancheng Yue Fei defeated Wuzhu's cavalry.

links.text_zh: 韩世忠质问秦桧岳飞之罪，“莫须有三字何以服天下”。
links.text: Han Shizhong challenged Qin Hui over Yue Fei's baseless conviction.

links.text_zh: 秦桧以“莫须有”罪名杀害岳飞。
links.text: Qin Hui had Yue Fei killed on the charge of 'perhaps'.

links.text_zh: 陆游应试名列秦桧孙之前，遭秦桧黜落。
links.text: Lu You outranked Qin Hui's grandson in the exam and was failed by Qin Hui.

links.text_zh: 杨万里与范成大同年中进士，终生交好。
links.text: Yang Wanli and Fan Chengda passed the exam the same year and stayed friends.

links.text_zh: 郑樵受宋高宗召见，后献上《通志》。
links.text: Zheng Qiao was received by Gaozong and later presented his Tongzhi.

links.text_zh: 虞允文以文臣督师，为宋高宗守住长江。
links.text: Civil official Yu Yunwen held the Yangtze line for Gaozong.

links.text_zh: 采石之战，虞允文击败完颜亮渡江金军。
links.text: At Caishi Yu Yunwen repelled Wanyan Liang's crossing.

links.text_zh: 洪迈受宋高宗派遣出使金国。
links.text: Hong Mai was sent by Gaozong as envoy to the Jin.

links.text_zh: 丘处机拜王重阳为师，为全真七子之一。
links.text: Qiu Chuji became Wang Chongyang's disciple, one of the Seven Perfected.

links.text_zh: 朱熹访张栻于岳麓书院，二人会讲两月。
links.text: Zhu Xi visited Zhang Shi at Yuelu Academy for two months of debate.

links.text_zh: 叶适早年从吕祖谦等人游学。
links.text: The young Ye Shi studied with Lü Zuqian.

links.text_zh: 张栻、吕祖谦与朱熹并称“东南三贤”。
links.text: Zhang Shi, Lü Zuqian and Zhu Xi were called the Three Worthies of the Southeast.

links.text_zh: 周去非在桂林与范成大共事，著《岭外代答》。
links.text: Zhou Qufei worked alongside Fan Chengda in Guilin and wrote on the far south.

links.text_zh: 陆游在成都入范成大幕府，二人以文字交。
links.text: Lu You served on Fan Chengda's staff in Chengdu as a literary friend.

links.text_zh: 吕祖谦邀陆九渊兄弟赴鹅湖与朱熹论学。
links.text: Lü Zuqian invited Lu Jiuyuan to Goose Lake to meet Zhu Xi.

links.text_zh: 吕祖谦与朱熹合编理学入门书《近思录》。
links.text: Lü Zuqian and Zhu Xi co-compiled the Jinsi Lu.

links.text_zh: 鹅湖之会，朱熹与陆九渊辩论治学之方。
links.text: At Goose Lake Zhu Xi and Lu Jiuyuan debated how to pursue learning.

links.text_zh: 陆游与朱熹交好，常有书信往来。
links.text: Lu You and Zhu Xi were friends who corresponded often.

links.text_zh: 叶适与陈亮同为浙东事功学派，交谊深厚。
links.text: Ye Shi and Chen Liang, both utilitarian thinkers, were close friends.

links.text_zh: 辛弃疾与朱熹交好，朱熹去世后作文祭之。
links.text: Xin Qiji was a friend of Zhu Xi and mourned him.

links.text_zh: 陈亮与朱熹书信往复，展开王霸义利之辩。
links.text: Chen Liang and Zhu Xi debated kingship and profit by letter.

links.text_zh: 杨万里赏识姜夔，并将他介绍给范成大。
links.text: Yang Wanli admired Jiang Kui and introduced him to Fan Chengda.

check.n: Wikipedia says Xiao Deyao introduced Jiang Kui to Yang Wanli in 1187; it does not say Yang introduced him to Fan Chengda.
check.n_zh: 维基称1187年经萧德藻介绍姜夔谒见杨万里，并未说杨万里把他引荐给范成大。

links.text_zh: 辛弃疾作《破阵子·为陈同甫赋壮词以寄之》。
links.text: Xin Qiji wrote 'Pozhenzi' for Chen Liang after their meeting.

links.text_zh: 陆游与杨万里同为中兴诗人，诗书往还。
links.text: Lu You and Yang Wanli, great poets of the age, exchanged poems.

links.text_zh: 姜夔在范成大石湖别墅作《暗香》《疏影》。
links.text: Jiang Kui composed 'Hidden Fragrance' and 'Sparse Shadows' at Fan Chengda's estate.

links.text_zh: 马远与夏圭同为画院画家，并称“马夏”。
links.text: Ma Yuan and Xia Gui, academy painters, were paired as 'Ma-Xia'.

links.text_zh: 姜夔作《永遇乐·次稼轩北固楼词韵》和辛弃疾。
links.text: Jiang Kui matched Xin Qiji's Beigu Pavilion lyric.

links.text_zh: 陆游作《送辛幼安殿撰造朝》诗送辛弃疾入朝。
links.text: Lu You wrote a poem seeing Xin Qiji off to court.

links.text_zh: 忽必烈是成吉思汗之孙。
links.text: Kublai was a grandson of Genghis Khan.

links.text_zh: 中都陷落后，耶律楚材被成吉思汗召用。
links.text: After Zhongdu fell, Yelü Chucai was summoned to serve Genghis Khan.

links.text_zh: 丘处机西行至大雪山觐见成吉思汗，劝其止杀。
links.text: Qiu Chuji travelled west to meet Genghis Khan and urged him to stop killing.

links.text_zh: 耶律楚材在西域与丘处机相识，诗文唱和。
links.text: Yelü Chucai met Qiu Chuji in Central Asia and exchanged poems.

links.text_zh: 汴京陷落后元好问收养教导幼年白朴。
links.text: After Kaifeng fell, Yuan Haowen sheltered and taught the young Bai Pu.

links.text_zh: 元好问作《寄中书耶律公书》，请耶律楚材保护儒士。
links.text: Yuan Haowen wrote to Yelü Chucai asking him to protect scholars.

links.text_zh: 刘克庄与宋慈交好，宋慈卒后为其撰墓志铭。
links.text: Liu Kezhuang was Song Ci's friend and wrote his epitaph.

links.text_zh: 郭守敬少年时在紫金山从刘秉忠学习。
links.text: Young Guo Shoujing studied under Liu Bingzhong at Zijin Mountain.

links.text_zh: 元好问与名医李杲交好，为其医书作序。
links.text: Yuan Haowen befriended physician Li Gao and prefaced his medical work.

links.text_zh: 八思巴为忽必烈授佛法灌顶，后被尊为帝师。
links.text: Phagpa gave Kublai Buddhist initiation and later became Imperial Preceptor.

links.text_zh: 胡三省与文天祥同年考中进士。
links.text: Hu Sanxing passed the jinshi exam in the same year as Wen Tianxiang.

links.text_zh: 刘秉忠为忽必烈规划建造开平城。
links.text: Liu Bingzhong planned the city of Kaiping for Kublai.

links.text_zh: 文天祥与陆秀夫同榜进士，后共撑南宋残局。
links.text: Wen Tianxiang and Lu Xiufu passed the same exam and later fought for Song together.

links.text_zh: 刘克庄上奏状反对秦九韶出知临江军。
links.text: Liu Kezhuang memorialised against Qin Jiushao's appointment.

links.text_zh: 鄂州之战，贾似道督师抵御忽必烈。
links.text: Jia Sidao led the defence of Ezhou against Kublai.

links.text_zh: 尼泊尔匠师阿尼哥随八思巴来到元廷。
links.text: Nepalese artisan Araniko came to the Yuan court under Phagpa.

links.text_zh: 阿合马受忽必烈重用，主管财政多年。
links.text: Ahmad served Kublai for years as head of state finances.

links.text_zh: 阿尼哥为忽必烈修复铜像，主持建造白塔。
links.text: Araniko worked for Kublai, building the White Dagoba.

links.text_zh: 伯颜受忽必烈重用，统帅大军灭南宋。
links.text: Bayan served Kublai and commanded the conquest of Song.

links.text_zh: 八思巴奉忽必烈之命创制八思巴文。
links.text: Phagpa created the Phagspa script at Kublai's command.

links.text_zh: 许衡上疏反对阿合马专权。
links.text: Xu Heng memorialised against Ahmad's domination of state affairs.

links.text_zh: 许衡受忽必烈任为集贤大学士兼国子祭酒。
links.text: Xu Heng served Kublai as chancellor of the Imperial Academy.

links.text_zh: 丁家洲之战，伯颜大败贾似道率领的宋军。
links.text: At Dingjiazhou Bayan crushed Jia Sidao's Song army.

links.text_zh: 马可·波罗来到元朝，受忽必烈任用多年。
links.text: Marco Polo reached China and served Kublai for years.

links.text_zh: 赵孟頫早年向同乡钱选请教画艺。
links.text: The young Zhao Mengfu learned painting from Qian Xuan.

links.text_zh: 文天祥出使元营与伯颜抗争，被扣留。
links.text: Wen Tianxiang argued with Bayan as envoy and was detained.

links.text_zh: 许衡与郭守敬等人共同修订新历。
links.text: Xu Heng worked with Guo Shoujing on the new calendar.

links.text_zh: 张弘范受忽必烈任为蒙古汉军都元帅南征。
links.text: Zhang Hongfan was appointed by Kublai to lead the final southern campaign.

links.text_zh: 张弘范率元军在五坡岭俘获文天祥。
links.text: Zhang Hongfan's Yuan army captured Wen Tianxiang at Wupoling.

links.text_zh: 张弘范逼文天祥招降，文天祥书《过零丁洋》以明志。
links.text: Pressed by Zhang Hongfan to call for surrender, Wen wrote 'Crossing Lingding Sea'.

links.text_zh: 崖山海战，张弘范击败宋军，陆秀夫负幼帝投海。
links.text: At Yamen Zhang Hongfan defeated Song; Lu Xiufu leapt into the sea with the boy emperor.

links.text_zh: 郭守敬奉忽必烈之命编订《授时历》。
links.text: Guo Shoujing compiled the Shoushi calendar for Kublai.

links.text_zh: 忽必烈劝降文天祥不成，下令处死。
links.text: Unable to win over Wen Tianxiang, Kublai had him executed.

links.text_zh: 赵孟頫被荐入京，受忽必烈赏识任官。
links.text: Zhao Mengfu was recommended to court and appointed by Kublai.

links.text_zh: 赵孟頫作《送吴幼清南还序》送吴澄南归。
links.text: Zhao Mengfu wrote a farewell preface for Wu Cheng returning south.

links.text_zh: 王蒙是赵孟頫的外孙。
links.text: Wang Meng was Zhao Mengfu's grandson through his daughter.

links.text_zh: 黄公望自称“松雪斋中小学生”，受赵孟頫影响。
links.text: Huang Gongwang called himself a little student of Zhao Mengfu.

links.text_zh: 黄公望与倪瓒同为元四家，交往密切。
links.text: Huang Gongwang and Ni Zan, two Yuan masters, were close friends.

links.text_zh: 王蒙与黄公望交游，得其指点。
links.text: Wang Meng associated with Huang Gongwang and learned from him.

links.text_zh: 杨维桢与黄公望交好，常为其画题诗。
links.text: Yang Weizhen was Huang Gongwang's friend and inscribed his paintings.

links.text_zh: 相传罗贯中是施耐庵的门人，参与《水浒传》编次。
links.text: Tradition holds Luo Guanzhong was Shi Nai'an's disciple and helped edit Water Margin.

links.text_zh: 宋濂与同乡名医朱丹溪交好，后为其撰写墓表。
links.text: Song Lian befriended the physician Zhu Danxi and wrote his tomb inscription.

links.text_zh: 刘福通发动红巾军起义，脱脱主政时派兵镇压。
links.text: Liu Futong raised the Red Turbans; Toqto'a's government sent troops against them.

links.text_zh: 徐达追随同乡朱元璋起兵，成为开国第一功臣。
links.text: Xu Da followed Zhu Yuanzhang and became the foremost founding general.

links.text_zh: 李善长投奔朱元璋，掌管后勤，后为开国丞相。
links.text: Li Shanchang joined Zhu Yuanzhang, ran supply and became chancellor.

links.text_zh: 脱脱率大军围攻据守高邮的张士诚。
links.text: Toqto'a besieged Zhang Shicheng at Gaoyou.

links.text_zh: 常遇春投奔朱元璋，屡为先锋。
links.text: Chang Yuchun joined Zhu Yuanzhang and often led the vanguard.

links.text_zh: 刘基与宋濂同被朱元璋征召，交谊深厚。
links.text: Liu Ji and Song Lian were summoned together and were close friends.

links.text_zh: 刘基应朱元璋之聘，献时务十八策。
links.text: Liu Ji answered Zhu Yuanzhang's summons and offered strategy.

links.text_zh: 倪瓒与王蒙常相唱和，互题画作。
links.text: Ni Zan and Wang Meng exchanged poems and inscribed each other's works.

links.text_zh: 宋濂受朱元璋征召，为太子讲经。
links.text: Song Lian was summoned by Zhu Yuanzhang to tutor the crown prince.

links.text_zh: 明成祖朱棣是朱元璋第四子。
links.text: Zhu Di was Zhu Yuanzhang's fourth son.

links.text_zh: 鄱阳湖之战，朱元璋击败陈友谅，陈中箭身亡。
links.text: At Poyang Lake Zhu Yuanzhang defeated Chen Youliang, who died by an arrow.

links.text_zh: 徐达与常遇春为正副统帅，共率北伐。
links.text: Xu Da and Chang Yuchun led the northern expedition together.

links.text_zh: 徐达率军围攻平江，擒张士诚。
links.text: Xu Da besieged Pingjiang and captured Zhang Shicheng.

links.text_zh: 朱元璋攻破平江，俘获张士诚。
links.text: Zhu Yuanzhang took Pingjiang and captured Zhang Shicheng.

links.text_zh: 刘基与丞相李善长不和，因李彬案结怨。
links.text: Liu Ji clashed with chancellor Li Shanchang over the Li Bin case.

links.text_zh: 朱元璋召杨维桢入京修礼乐书。
links.text: Zhu Yuanzhang summoned Yang Weizhen to compile ritual texts.

check.n: Wikipedia says the Taizu Emperor summoned him to the capital in the second year of Hongwu (1369); he died in 1370.
check.n_zh: 维基载洪武二年（1369年）明太祖召其至京师议订礼法，1370年逝世。

links.text_zh: 方孝孺拜宋濂为师，为其得意门生。
links.text: Fang Xiaoru became Song Lian's favourite disciple.

links.text_zh: 徐达之女嫁燕王朱棣，即后来的徐皇后。
links.text: Xu Da's daughter married Zhu Di and became Empress Xu.

links.text_zh: 解缙中进士后受朱元璋赏识，上《大庖西封事》。
links.text: Xie Jin won Zhu Yuanzhang's favour and submitted a famous memorial.

links.text_zh: 朱元璋以胡惟庸案牵连，赐死李善长。
links.text: Zhu Yuanzhang had Li Shanchang killed in the Hu Weiyong purge.

links.text_zh: 方孝孺拒为朱棣草即位诏书，被诛十族。
links.text: Fang Xiaoru refused to draft Zhu Di's accession edict and was executed with his clan.

links.text_zh: 解缙受朱棣之命主持编纂《永乐大典》。
links.text: Xie Jin compiled the Yongle Encyclopedia for the Yongle Emperor.

links.text_zh: 郑和奉永乐帝朱棣之命率船队下西洋。
links.text: Zheng He led the treasure fleets on the Yongle Emperor's orders.

links.text_zh: 解缙因卷入储位之争获罪朱棣，死于狱中。
links.text: Xie Jin offended Zhu Di over the succession and died in prison.

links.text_zh: 蒯祥为永乐帝主持营建北京紫禁城宫殿。
links.text: Kuai Xiang designed palace halls of the Forbidden City for the Yongle Emperor.

check.n: Wikipedia says Kuai Xiang was ordered to design the Forbidden City in 1407, and most palaces were finished by end 1417, so 1417 is the completion not the start.
check.n_zh: 维基称蒯祥于1407年奉命设计营建紫禁城，1417年底宫殿大体完工，1417年并非起始年。

links.text_zh: 朱祁镇夺门复辟后，以谋逆罪杀害于谦。
links.text: After regaining the throne in a coup, Zhu Qizhen had Yu Qian executed.

links.text_zh: 文徵明从沈周学画，后继为吴门画派领袖。
links.text: Wen Zhengming learned painting from Shen Zhou and later led the Wu School.

links.text_zh: 唐寅曾向吴门前辈沈周学画。
links.text: Tang Yin learned painting from the Wu School elder Shen Zhou.

check.n: Wikipedia says Tang Yin may have learned from Shen Zhou early on but shows little Shen influence and mainly studied under Zhou Chen.
check.n_zh: 维基称唐寅早年可能向沈周学画，但作品少见沈周风格，主要师从周臣。

links.text_zh: 唐寅与文徵明自少年相交，同列吴中四才子。
links.text: Tang Yin and Wen Zhengming were boyhood friends and fellow Suzhou talents.

links.text_zh: 唐寅与祝允明同为“吴中四才子”，交情深厚。
links.text: Tang Yin and Zhu Yunming were close friends among the Four Talents of Wuzhong.

links.text_zh: 文徵明与祝允明同为吴中四才子，诗书往来。
links.text: Wen Zhengming and Zhu Yunming were friends who exchanged poems and calligraphy.

links.text_zh: 王阳明早年在京与李梦阳等诗文唱和。
links.text: As a young official Wang Yangming exchanged poems with Li Mengyang in Beijing.

links.text_zh: 王艮拜王阳明为师，后创泰州学派。
links.text: Wang Gen became Wang Yangming's disciple and later founded the Taizhou school.

links.text_zh: 罗洪先私淑王阳明心学，成为江右王门代表。
links.text: Luo Hongxian adopted Wang Yangming's learning and led its Jiangxi branch.

links.text_zh: 仇英常作画，文徵明为之题字，二人多有合作。
links.text: Qiu Ying often painted works that Wen Zhengming inscribed.

links.text_zh: 严嵩构陷王世贞之父王忬致死，结下深仇。
links.text: Yan Song had Wang Shizhen's father executed, making them bitter enemies.

links.text_zh: 戚继光与俞大猷并称“俞龙戚虎”，共平倭寇。
links.text: Qi Jiguang and Yu Dayou fought the wokou side by side, called 'Yu dragon, Qi tiger'.

links.text_zh: 归有光斥王世贞为“妄庸巨子”，反对复古派。
links.text: Gui Youguang attacked Wang Shizhen's archaist school as shallow.

links.text_zh: 吴承恩任长兴县丞时，与知县归有光共事交好。
links.text: Wu Cheng'en served as assistant magistrate under his friend Gui Youguang at Changxing.

links.text_zh: 张居正倚重戚继光镇守蓟州、修筑长城。
links.text: Zhang Juzheng backed Qi Jiguang to guard Jizhou and rebuild the Great Wall.

links.text_zh: 张居正忌惮海瑞刚直，执政期间始终不予起用。
links.text: Zhang Juzheng distrusted Hai Rui's rigidity and kept him out of office.

links.text_zh: 张居正以首辅身份兼任少年万历帝的老师。
links.text: As senior grand secretary, Zhang Juzheng also tutored the young Wanli Emperor.

links.text_zh: 张居正辅佐万历帝推行考成法与一条鞭法。
links.text: Zhang Juzheng carried out reforms in the Wanli Emperor's name.

links.text_zh: 汤显祖拒绝结交张居正之子，因而屡试不第。
links.text: Tang Xianzu refused to befriend Zhang Juzheng's sons and failed the exams.

links.text_zh: 张居正支持潘季驯“束水攻沙”治理黄河。
links.text: Zhang Juzheng backed Pan Jixun's plan to tame the Yellow River.

links.text_zh: 王世贞为李时珍《本草纲目》作序。
links.text: Wang Shizhen wrote the preface to Li Shizhen's Compendium of Materia Medica.

links.text_zh: 徐渭读汤显祖诗文后致书《与汤义仍》大加赞赏。
links.text: Xu Wei wrote Tang Xianzu a letter praising his early poetry.

links.text_zh: 袁宏道兄弟到麻城拜访李贽，深受其思想影响。
links.text: Yuan Hongdao visited Li Zhi at Macheng and was deeply influenced by him.

links.text_zh: 汤显祖在端州遇利玛窦，作诗记其事。
links.text: Tang Xianzu met Matteo Ricci at Zhaoqing and wrote a poem about him.

links.text_zh: 皇太极是努尔哈赤第八子，继位为后金大汗。
links.text: Hong Taiji was Nurhaci's eighth son and succeeded him as khan.

links.text_zh: 顾宪成因会推阁臣忤万历帝意，被革职回乡。
links.text: Gu Xiancheng angered the Wanli Emperor and was dismissed from office.

links.text_zh: 汤显祖与袁宏道志趣相投，书信往来频繁。
links.text: Tang Xianzu and Yuan Hongdao were like-minded friends who corresponded often.

links.text_zh: 袁宏道致信董其昌，询问《金瓶梅》抄本来历。
links.text: Yuan Hongdao wrote to his friend Dong Qichang asking about his Jin Ping Mei copy.

links.text_zh: 李贽在南京结识利玛窦，作《赠利西泰》相赠。
links.text: Li Zhi met Matteo Ricci in Nanjing and wrote him the poem Zeng Li Xitai.

links.text_zh: 利玛窦进京向万历帝献自鸣钟，获准留居北京。
links.text: Ricci presented clocks to the Wanli Emperor and was allowed to stay in Beijing.

links.text_zh: 利玛窦口授、徐光启笔录，合译《几何原本》。
links.text: Ricci and Xu Guangqi jointly translated Euclid's Elements into Chinese.

links.text_zh: 徐光启在北京从利玛窦学习西方天文历算。
links.text: Xu Guangqi studied Western astronomy and mathematics with Ricci in Beijing.

links.text_zh: 皇太极与多尔衮为同父兄弟，多尔衮随兄征战。
links.text: Hong Taiji and Dorgon were half-brothers; Dorgon fought under him.

links.text_zh: 多尔衮是努尔哈赤第十四子。
links.text: Dorgon was Nurhaci's fourteenth son.

links.text_zh: 艾儒略随徐光启赴上海一带传教。
links.text: Giulio Aleni went to preach around Shanghai with Xu Guangqi.

links.text_zh: 努尔哈赤以“七大恨”告天，起兵反抗万历朝明廷。
links.text: Nurhaci proclaimed his Seven Grievances and rose against Wanli's Ming.

links.text_zh: 孙承宗赏识袁崇焕，委以修筑宁远城重任。
links.text: Sun Chengzong promoted Yuan Chonghuan and had him fortify Ningyuan.

links.text_zh: 孙承宗遭魏忠贤一党排挤，被迫辞去督师。
links.text: Sun Chengzong was forced out of his command by Wei Zhongxian's faction.

links.text_zh: 袁崇焕在宁远之战中击败努尔哈赤。
links.text: Yuan Chonghuan defeated Nurhaci at the Battle of Ningyuan.

links.text_zh: 崇祯帝即位后清除魏忠贤，魏自缢而死。
links.text: The Chongzhen Emperor purged Wei Zhongxian, who hanged himself.

links.text_zh: 袁崇焕在宁锦之战中击退皇太极。
links.text: Yuan Chonghuan repelled Hong Taiji at the Battle of Ning-Jin.

check.n: The Hong Taiji article says he was defeated by Yuan Chonghuan in 1628, while the Yuan article only says the second Battle of Ningyuan, so the year is unclear.
check.n_zh: 皇太极条目称其1628年被袁崇焕击败，袁崇焕条目仅称第二次宁远之战，年份不明确。

links.text_zh: 崇祯帝起用袁崇焕督师蓟辽，许以五年复辽。
links.text: The Chongzhen Emperor made Yuan Chonghuan commander in Liaodong.

links.text_zh: 徐光启奉崇祯帝之命督修历法，官至内阁大学士。
links.text: Xu Guangqi reformed the calendar for the Chongzhen Emperor as Grand Secretary.

links.text_zh: 崇祯帝召见秦良玉，御赐诗四首表彰其勤王。
links.text: The Chongzhen Emperor received Qin Liangyu and honoured her with four poems.

links.text_zh: 崇祯帝中反间计，将袁崇焕凌迟处死。
links.text: Misled by Qing intrigue, the Chongzhen Emperor had Yuan Chonghuan executed.

links.text_zh: 徐光启主持历局，召汤若望参与修《崇祯历书》。
links.text: Xu Guangqi brought Adam Schall into the bureau compiling the Chongzhen calendar.

links.text_zh: 张岱与陈洪绶交好，《陶庵梦忆》记二人同游。
links.text: Zhang Dai and Chen Hongshou were friends, as Zhang's memoirs record.

links.text_zh: 多尔衮率清军攻高阳，孙承宗率众守城殉国。
links.text: Sun Chengzong died defending Gaoyang against Dorgon's invading army.

links.text_zh: 洪承畴在潼关南原大败李自成。
links.text: Hong Chengchou crushed Li Zicheng near Tongguan.

check.n: Source places the 1638 defeat of Li Zicheng on the Shaanxi-Sichuan border, not near Tongguan.
check.n_zh: 维基称1638年洪承畴在陕川边境击败李自成，未提潼关。

links.text_zh: 秦良玉率白杆兵在川东阻击张献忠。
links.text: Qin Liangyu led her troops against Zhang Xianzhong in eastern Sichuan.

check.n: Sources date Qin's defeat of Zhang Xianzhong at Kuizhou to 1634 and her defeat by him to 1644; 1640 was against Luo Rucai.
check.n_zh: 维基载秦良玉1634年败张献忠于夔州，1640年所败为罗汝才，1644年反被张击败。

links.text_zh: 洪承畴率明军在松锦之战中被皇太极击败。
links.text: Hong Chengchou's Ming army was defeated by Hong Taiji at Song-Jin.

links.text_zh: 洪承畴兵败被俘，降清为皇太极所重用。
links.text: Captured, Hong Chengchou surrendered and served Hong Taiji.

links.text_zh: 崇祯帝任史可法为南京兵部尚书。
links.text: The Chongzhen Emperor appointed Shi Kefa minister of war in Nanjing.

links.text_zh: 汤若望向多尔衮进呈新历，掌钦天监。
links.text: Adam Schall presented his calendar to Dorgon and headed the Astronomical Bureau.

links.text_zh: 多尔衮率清军入关，在山海关大败李自成。
links.text: Dorgon led the Qing army through Shanhai Pass and routed Li Zicheng.

links.text_zh: 李自成攻破北京，崇祯帝自缢于煤山。
links.text: Li Zicheng took Beijing and the Chongzhen Emperor hanged himself.

links.text_zh: 多尔衮致书劝降，史可法作《复多尔衮书》拒绝。
links.text: Shi Kefa rejected Dorgon's call to surrender in his famous reply letter.

links.text_zh: 崇祯帝封吴三桂为平西伯，召其入卫京师。
links.text: The Chongzhen Emperor ennobled Wu Sangui and summoned him to defend Beijing.

links.text_zh: 吴三桂向多尔衮借兵降清，受封平西王。
links.text: Wu Sangui joined Dorgon and was made Prince Pacifier of the West.

links.text_zh: 吴三桂引清兵在山海关击败李自成。
links.text: Wu Sangui, with Qing troops, defeated Li Zicheng at Shanhai Pass.

links.text_zh: 洪承畴受多尔衮之命招抚江南。
links.text: Hong Chengchou pacified the Jiangnan region on Dorgon's orders.

links.text_zh: 郑成功杀施琅父兄，施琅降清与郑氏为敌。
links.text: Zheng Chenggong killed Shi Lang's family, and Shi Lang defected to the Qing.

links.text_zh: 南怀仁协助汤若望治历，同遭康熙历狱。
links.text: Verbiest assisted Schall at the bureau and shared his trial in the calendar case.

links.text_zh: 南怀仁为康熙帝讲授天文、数学。
links.text: Ferdinand Verbiest taught astronomy and mathematics to the Kangxi Emperor.

links.text_zh: 吴三桂起兵反清，康熙帝调兵平定三藩。
links.text: The Kangxi Emperor fought and crushed Wu Sangui's Revolt of the Three Feudatories.

links.text_zh: 顾炎武致书黄宗羲，盛赞《明夷待访录》。
links.text: Gu Yanwu wrote to Huang Zongxi praising his Waiting for the Dawn.

links.text_zh: 纳兰性德中进士后任康熙帝一等侍卫。
links.text: Nalan Xingde served as the Kangxi Emperor's personal bodyguard.

links.text_zh: 雍正帝胤禛是康熙帝第四子。
links.text: The Yongzheng Emperor was the Kangxi Emperor's fourth son.

links.text_zh: 吴三桂衡州称帝，王夫之拒写劝进表。
links.text: Wang Fuzhi refused to write a petition urging Wu Sangui to take the throne.

links.text_zh: 施琅奉康熙帝之命攻取澎湖、统一台湾。
links.text: Shi Lang took Penghu and Taiwan for the Kangxi Emperor.

links.text_zh: 康熙帝至曲阜祭孔，孔尚任讲经受赏，授国子监博士。
links.text: Kong Shangren lectured before Kangxi at Qufu and was given a court post.

links.text_zh: 石涛在扬州接驾康熙帝南巡，作诗纪事。
links.text: Shitao greeted the Kangxi Emperor on his southern tour and wrote poems about it.

links.text_zh: 石涛与朱耷同为明宗室遗民画家，书信往来合作作画。
links.text: Shitao and Bada Shanren, both Ming royal heirs, corresponded and painted together.

links.text_zh: 康熙帝南巡召见梅文鼎，御书“绩学参微”相赐。
links.text: Kangxi met Mei Wending on tour and gave him a calligraphy plaque.

check.n: The Chinese article places Kangxi's southern tour meeting with Mei Wending the year after 1702, i.e. 1703.
check.n_zh: 中文维基称康熙四十一年荐书，次年南巡召见梅文鼎，即1703年。

links.text_zh: 康熙帝晚年喜爱孙儿弘历，带入宫中养育。
links.text: The Kangxi Emperor doted on his grandson Hongli and raised him at court.

links.text_zh: 乾隆帝弘历是雍正帝第四子。
links.text: The Qianlong Emperor was the Yongzheng Emperor's fourth son.

links.text_zh: 郎世宁供奉雍正内廷，绘《百骏图》。
links.text: Castiglione painted the Hundred Horses as Yongzheng's court painter.

links.text_zh: 年羹尧受雍正帝重用，平定青海罗卜藏丹津。
links.text: Nian Gengyao crushed the Qinghai revolt for the Yongzheng Emperor.

links.text_zh: 雍正帝列年羹尧九十二条大罪，令其自裁。
links.text: The Yongzheng Emperor charged Nian Gengyao with 92 crimes and forced his suicide.

links.text_zh: 郑板桥与金农同为“扬州八怪”，诗画相交。
links.text: Zheng Banqiao and Jin Nong were friends among the Eight Eccentrics of Yangzhou.

links.text_zh: 郎世宁为乾隆帝作画，并参与设计圆明园西洋楼。
links.text: Castiglione painted for Qianlong and helped design the Yuanmingyuan's European palaces.

links.text_zh: 刘墉中进士后历官乾隆朝，以清廉著称。
links.text: Liu Yong served the Qianlong Emperor as an upright official.

links.text_zh: 纪昀赏识戴震，为其刊刻《考工记图》。
links.text: Ji Yun befriended Dai Zhen and printed his study of the Kaogong ji.

links.text_zh: 段玉裁拜戴震为师，传其文字训诂之学。
links.text: Duan Yucai became Dai Zhen's disciple in philology.

links.text_zh: 纪昀奉乾隆帝之命任《四库全书》总纂官。
links.text: Ji Yun was chief editor of the Siku Quanshu for the Qianlong Emperor.

links.text_zh: 和珅深得乾隆帝宠信，权倾朝野。
links.text: Heshen was the Qianlong Emperor's all-powerful favourite.

links.text_zh: 马戛尔尼率英使团在承德觐见乾隆帝。
links.text: Macartney led the British embassy to an audience with Qianlong at Chengde.

links.text_zh: 林则徐将《四洲志》资料交给魏源，编成《海国图志》。
links.text: Lin Zexu gave Wei Yuan his materials, which became the Haiguo Tuzhi.

links.text_zh: 李鸿章早年拜曾国藩为师，学习经世之学。
links.text: Li Hongzhang studied under Zeng Guofan as a young scholar.

links.text_zh: 林则徐与左宗棠湘江舟中夜谈，以西北边事相托。
links.text: Lin Zexu met Zuo Zongtang on the Xiang River and entrusted him with the northwest.

links.text_zh: 曾国藩创湘军与洪秀全的太平天国作战。
links.text: Zeng Guofan raised the Xiang Army to fight Hong Xiuquan's Taiping regime.

links.text_zh: 李鸿章入曾国藩幕府，后受命组建淮军。
links.text: Li Hongzhang joined Zeng Guofan's staff and later built the Huai Army.

links.text_zh: 李秀成为洪秀全效力，受封忠王。
links.text: Li Xiucheng served Hong Xiuquan and was made the Loyal King.

links.text_zh: 左宗棠经曾国藩举荐，率楚军征战浙江。
links.text: Recommended by Zeng Guofan, Zuo Zongtang led troops in Zhejiang.

links.text_zh: 李鸿章率淮军在上海击退李秀成。
links.text: Li Hongzhang's Huai Army drove Li Xiucheng back from Shanghai.

links.text_zh: 李善兰与徐寿同在安庆、江南制造局译书造器。
links.text: Li Shanlan and Xu Shou worked together at Anqing and the Jiangnan Arsenal.

links.text_zh: 刘铭传为李鸿章淮军名将，后任台湾巡抚。
links.text: Liu Mingchuan was a Huai Army general under Li Hongzhang.

links.text_zh: 徐寿入曾国藩安庆内军械所，造出“黄鹄”号轮船。
links.text: Xu Shou built the steamer Huanghu at Zeng Guofan's Anqing arsenal.

links.text_zh: 李善兰入曾国藩幕，曾资助刊刻其译著。
links.text: Li Shanlan joined Zeng Guofan's staff, and Zeng funded his translations.

links.text_zh: 天京陷落后李秀成被俘，曾国藩审讯后处死。
links.text: After Nanjing fell, Zeng Guofan interrogated and executed the captured Li Xiucheng.

links.text_zh: 曾国藩与左宗棠因幼天王出逃一事失和。
links.text: Zeng Guofan and Zuo Zongtang fell out over the Taiping heir's escape.

links.text_zh: 严复与邓世昌同为福州船政学堂首届学生。
links.text: Yan Fu and Deng Shichang were in the first class of the Fuzhou naval school.

links.text_zh: 李鸿章受慈禧倚重，主持洋务与外交。
links.text: Li Hongzhang ran foreign affairs and modernization for Empress Dowager Cixi.

links.text_zh: 李鸿章主海防、左宗棠主塞防，二人激烈争论。
links.text: Li Hongzhang (sea defence) and Zuo Zongtang (frontier defence) clashed over strategy.

links.text_zh: 慈禧立亲妹之子载湉为光绪帝，垂帘听政。
links.text: Cixi put her sister's son on the throne as the Guangxu Emperor.

links.text_zh: 邓世昌在李鸿章创建的北洋水师任管带。
links.text: Deng Shichang commanded a cruiser in Li Hongzhang's Beiyang Fleet.

links.text_zh: 李鸿章调严复任北洋水师学堂总教习。
links.text: Li Hongzhang appointed Yan Fu to head the Beiyang Naval Academy.

links.text_zh: 袁世凯受李鸿章提拔，驻朝鲜并编练新军。
links.text: Yuan Shikai rose as Li Hongzhang's protégé in Korea and in army reform.

links.text_zh: 两广总督张之洞起用冯子材抗击法军。
links.text: Zhang Zhidong called Feng Zicai out of retirement to fight the French.

links.text_zh: 赫德协助李鸿章与法国议和，签订中法新约。
links.text: Robert Hart helped Li Hongzhang negotiate peace with France.

links.text_zh: 梁启超拜康有为为师，就读万木草堂。
links.text: Liang Qichao studied under Kang Youwei at the Wanmu Caotang.

links.text_zh: 孙中山作《上李鸿章书》，提出改革主张。
links.text: Sun Yat-sen wrote a long letter to Li Hongzhang proposing reforms.

links.text_zh: 康有为与梁启超联合各省举人公车上书。
links.text: Kang Youwei and Liang Qichao led provincial candidates in a joint petition.

links.text_zh: 梁启超与严复书信讨论《天演论》与变法。
links.text: Liang Qichao and Yan Fu corresponded about evolution and reform.

links.text_zh: 谭嗣同与梁启超志同道合，共倡维新。
links.text: Tan Sitong and Liang Qichao were close friends in the reform cause.

links.text_zh: 张之洞因康有为用孔子纪年，停办《强学报》。
links.text: Zhang Zhidong shut down Kang Youwei's reform paper over its Confucian calendar.

links.text_zh: 慈禧发动政变，终止变法，将光绪帝幽禁瀛台。
links.text: Cixi ended the reforms and kept the Guangxu Emperor under house arrest.

links.text_zh: 戊戌政变后慈禧下令处死谭嗣同等六君子。
links.text: Cixi ordered Tan Sitong and five others executed after the coup.

links.text_zh: 光绪帝召见康有为，采纳其主张推行戊戌变法。
links.text: The Guangxu Emperor received Kang Youwei and launched the Hundred Days' Reform.

links.text_zh: 光绪帝擢谭嗣同为军机章京，参与新政。
links.text: The Guangxu Emperor made Tan Sitong a secretary of the Grand Council.

links.text_zh: 谭嗣同夜访袁世凯求助，袁转而告密。
links.text: Tan Sitong sought Yuan Shikai's help, but Yuan betrayed the reformers.

links.text_zh: 秋瑾在东京加入孙中山的中国同盟会。
links.text: Qiu Jin joined Sun Yat-sen's Tongmenghui in Tokyo.

links.text_zh: 孙中山派《民报》与梁启超《新民丛报》论战。
links.text: Sun's Minbao and Liang's Xinmin Congbao debated revolution versus reform.

links.text_zh: 严复在伦敦会见孙中山，主张教育救国而非革命。
links.text: In London, Yan Fu told Sun Yat-sen that education, not revolution, came first.

links.text_zh: 直隶总督袁世凯委派詹天佑主持修筑京张铁路。
links.text: Yuan Shikai appointed Zhan Tianyou to build the Beijing-Zhangjiakou Railway.

links.text_zh: 张之洞与袁世凯联名奏请立停科举。
links.text: Zhang Zhidong and Yuan Shikai jointly petitioned to abolish the exams.

links.text_zh: 袁世凯任命严复为北京大学首任校长。
links.text: Yuan Shikai appointed Yan Fu first president of Peking University.

links.text_zh: 孙中山发动二次革命讨伐袁世凯。
links.text: Sun Yat-sen launched the Second Revolution against Yuan Shikai.
